author: andrew-murray
fields.title: Mukama Abeera Munda mu Ffe
fields.description: Mu “Mukama Abeera Munda mu Ffe,” Andrew Murray aluŋŋamya abasomi okukyusibwa mu bulamu bwabwe nga bayingiza Kristo, nga beewaayo eri Omwoyo Omutukuvu, era nga bava mu bikolo by’obuddu. Ekitabo kyogera ku nsonga enkulu ng’okuwangula obulamu bw’omubiri, okulindirira Katonda, n’okunoonya obwakabaka bwe okusooka, era kiwa okutegeera ku kwewaayo okujjuvu, ku mirembe, ku kubudaabudibwa mu kisa kya Katonda, ne ku Katonda okubeera munda mu ffe mu ngeri ey’ekitalo. Ebirimu: Mukama Abeera Munda mu Ffe—Abakristaayo ab’Omubiri—Obulamu bw’Okwefaako—Okulindirira Katonda—Okuyingira mu Kuwummula—Obwakabaka Okusooka—Kristo Bwe Bulamu Bwaffe—Obuwombeefu bwa Kristo – Bwe Bulokozi Bwaffe—Okwewaayo Okujjuvu—Abaafa wamu ne Kristo—Essanyu mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu—Okuwangula kw’Okukkiriza—Ensibuko y’Amaanyi mu Kusaba—Katonda Alyoke Abeere Byonna mu Byonna.

qa.question: Ekitabo Mukama Abeera Munda mu Ffe kyogera ku ki?
qa.answer: Kya kugatta okwogera kwa Andrew Murray ku maanyi ga Kristo agakyusa obulamu ng’abeera munda mu mukkiriza. Murray aluŋŋamya omusomi okwewaayo eri Kristo abeera munda n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Ayogera ku bulamu bw’Omukristaayo ow’omubiri, ku bikolo by’obuddu obw’omwoyo, ne ku kkubo erituusa mu bulamu obw’okuwummula, obutukuvu n’obuwanguzi, olw’okubeerawo kwa Mukama munda mu ffe.

qa.question: Andrew Murray yali ani?
qa.answer: Yali musumba ow’e Afirika ey’Obukiikaddyo, era omu ku bawandiisi abasinga okwagalibwa ab’ebitabo eby’okweyongera mu bulamu obw’Ekikristaayo obw’omunda. Yawandiika ebitabo bingi ebimpi ku kusaba, obuwombeefu n’okubeera mu Kristo. Mukama Abeera Munda mu Ffe kigatta okwogera kwe ku Kristo okubeera munda mu ffe, mu ngeri y’emu ey’ebbugumu era ey’okukebera omutima ng’ebitabo bye ebirala.

qa.question: Murray ategeeza ki bw’ayogera ku “Mukama okubeera munda mu ffe”?
qa.answer: Kwe kubeerawo kwa Kristo omulamu munda mu mukkiriza olw’Omwoyo we. Kristo si ky’okulabirako kyokka eky’okugoberera, wadde Omulokozi ali ebweru waffe, wabula bwe bulamu obubeera mu ffe era obutukyusa okuva munda. Murray ayigiriza nti ekyama ky’obulamu obutukuvu era obuwangula kwe kwewaayo eri Kristo oyo abeera munda, n’okumuleka abeere obulamu bwe mu ffe.

qa.question: Obulamu bw’Omukristaayo ow’omubiri Murray bw’ayogerako bwe buliwa?
qa.answer: Bwe bulamu bw’omukkiriza ow’amazima naye abeera mu kuwangulwa—afugibwa okwefaako, alwana mu maanyi g’omubiri, era abulwa okuwummula n’amaanyi Katonda by’ayagala abe nabyo. Murray ayogera ku mbeera eno mu bwesimbu, ng’alaga ebikolo byayo n’eddagala lyayo: si kwongera kufuba mu maanyi g’omuntu, wabula okwewaayo okujjuvu n’okwesigama ku Kristo abeera munda, yekka ayinza okumenya obuyinza bw’omubiri.

qa.question: Omuntu ayingira atya mu bulamu Murray bw’ayogerako?
qa.answer: Mu kwewaayo—okuwaayo ddala obulamu bwe eri Kristo, n’okwesigama mu kwesiga ku Mwoyo we abeera munda. Murray ayigiriza nti obulamu obukyusiddwa tebujja lwa kweyongera kulwana, wabula lwa kuleka Mukama abeera munda akole, n’okulekayo okwesiga amaanyi gaffe, n’okuwummulira mu Kristo abeere obulamu bwe mu ffe. Enkyukakyuka eyo mulimu gwa Kristo, ogufunibwa olw’okukkiriza n’okwewaayo.

qa.question: Ekitabo kino kikwatagana kitya n’ebitabo bya Murray Abide in Christ ne Okwewaayo Okujjuvu?
qa.answer: Kinyweza amazima ge gamu ag’omutima okuva ku ludda olulala. Abide in Christ kyogera ku kusigala mu ye, ate Okwewaayo Okujjuvu ku kwewaayo okujjuvu okw’obulamu bwonna; Mukama Abeera Munda mu Ffe kyogera ku Kristo okubeera munda mu mukkiriza ng’ensibuko y’obutukuvu n’obuwanguzi. Ebitabo ebyo byonna bisatu biyita omusomi okuva mu kufuba kw’amaanyi ge okuyingira mu bulamu obubeerawo okuva mu Kristo era olwa Kristo.

qa.question: Ekitabo kino kya ani?
qa.answer: Kya buli Mukristaayo amanyi okuwangulwa era eyeegomba obulamu obw’okuwummula, obutukuvu n’obuwanguzi, era alowooza nti okuddamu kuli wala okusinga okweyongera okufuba. Murray awandiikira omukkiriza anyiikira naye alwana, era ekitabo kimulaga Kristo abeera munda ng’ekyama ky’obulamu obukyusiddwa bw’anoonya.

qa.question: Omusomi asaanidde kutandikira wa?
qa.answer: Ku ntandikwa, ng’agoberera okwogera kwa Murray nga bwe kuddiriŋŋana, kubanga asooka kunnyonnyola bulamu bw’omubiri obuwanguddwa nga tannaba kuyingiza musomi mu bulamu bwa Kristo abeera munda. Essuula zino zaasooka kwogerwa mu lujjudde era zisomeka bulungi; bw’ozisoma ng’osaba era nga bwe ziddiriŋŋana, zisindika omusomi mpola eri okwewaayo n’okuwummula Murray bw’ayogerako.

fields.title: Abakristaayo ab’Omubiri
fields.body_html:
“Nange abooluganda ssaasobola kwogera nammwe ng’ab’omwoyo, naye nayogera nammwe ng’ab’omubiri” 1 Abakkolinso 3:1.

Wano omutume Pawulo ayogera ku mitendera ebiri egy’obulamu bw’Ekikristaayo, ku bika bibiri eby’Abakristaayo: “ssaasobola kwogera nammwe ng’ab’omwoyo, naye nayogera nammwe ng’ab’omubiri era ng’abaana abawere mu Kristo.” 1 Abakkolinso 3:1. Baali Bakristaayo, nga bali mu Kristo, naye mu kifo ky’okuba Abakristaayo ab’omwoyo, baali ba mubiri. “Nabanywesa mata so si mmere enkalubo, kubanga mwali temunnagisobola. Naye era ne kaakano temunnagisobola, kubanga mukyafugibwa mubiri.” 1 Abakkolinso 1:2-3 Wano ekigambo ekyo kiddamu omulundi ogwokubiri. “Naye obanga”—buno bwe bukakafu—“mukyalimu obuggya n’ennyombo, temufugibwa mubiri era temutambula ng’abalina empisa z’abantu obuntu? Kubanga omuntu yenna bw’agamba nti, Nze ndi wa Pawulo, n’omulala nti, Nze ndi wa Apolo, olwo temuba ng’abantu obuntu?” 1 Abakkolinso 3:2-4. Emirundi ena omutume alaga nti abantu abo ba mubiri. Mu magezi Omwoyo Omutukuvu ge yamuwa, Pawulo awulira nti: Siyinza kuwandiikira Bakristaayo bano ab’e Kkolinso okuggyako nga mmanyi embeera yaabwe, era nga ngibabuulira.

Bwe mpa emmere ey’omwoyo abo Abakristaayo ab’omubiri, mbakola kabi okusinga obulungi, kubanga tebasobola kugirya. Siyinza kubaliisa mmere enkalubo; nteekwa okubanywesa amata. Bw’atyo, ku ntandikwa y’ebbaluwa yennyini, abategeeza embeera yaabwe nga bw’agiraba.

Mu ssuula ebbiri ezisooka, Pawulo yali ayogedde ku buweereza bwe nga bwa Mwoyo Omutukuvu; kaakano atandika okubategeeza embeera abantu gye bateekwa okubaamu basobole okutoola amazima ag’omwoyo, era agamba nti: “Siyinza kwogera nammwe nga bwe nandyagadde, kubanga muli ba mubiri, era temusobola kutoola mazima ga mwoyo.” 1 Abakkolinso 3:1. Ekyo kituleetera ekirowoozo eky’amaanyi nti mu Kkanisa ya Kristo mulimu ebibiina bibiri eby’Abakristaayo. Abamu bamaze emyaka mingi nga bakkiriza, naye bulijjo basigala bawere; abalala bantu ba mwoyo kubanga beewaddeyo eri amaanyi, n’obukulembeze, n’obufuzi bwonna obw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Bwe tuba ab’okufuna omukisa, tusooke tusalewo kibiina ki ku bino kye tulimu. Ku bw’ekisa kya Katonda, tuli mu bulamu obw’omwoyo mu buwombeefu obungi, oba tuli mu bulamu obw’omubiri?

Kale ka tusooke tugezeeko okutegeera ekitegeezebwa embeera ey’omubiri abakkiriza gye bayinza okubeeramu.

Okuva ku bye tusanga mu Abakkolinso, tulaba obubonero buna obw’embeera ey’omubiri. Ekisooka: bwe buwere obulwawo ennyo. Mumanyi ekyo kye kitegeeza. Teebereza omwana omulungi ow’emyezi mukaaga. Tayinza kwogera, tayinza kutambula, naye ekyo tekitweraliikiriza; kya butonde, era bwe kiteekwa okuba. Naye teebereza nga wayise omwaka ne tusanga omwana talina w’akuze n’akatono, ate oluvannyuma lw’emyaka esatu nga tannakula; amangu ago twandigambye nti: “Wateekwa okubaawo obulwadde obw’entiisa;” n’omwana oyo eyali essanyu eri buli eyamulabanga ng’alina emyezi mukaaga, afuuse eri nnyina n’eri bonna ensibuko y’okweraliikirira n’ennaku. Waliwo ekitali kituufu; omwana tayinza kukula. Kyali kituufu ddala nti ku myezi mukaaga alye amata gokka, naye emyaka giyiseewo, era akyali munafu nga bwe yali. Kale eyo y’embeera y’abakkiriza bangi. Bakyuse; bamanyi kye kitegeeza okuba abakakafu n’okuba n’okukkiriza; bakkiriza okusonyiyibwa ebibi; batandika okukolera Katonda; naye mu ngeri emu oba endala, tebakula nnyo mu by’omwoyo, mu bulamu obwa ddala obw’omu ggulu.

Bwe tusisinkana nabo, amangu ago tuwulira nti waliwo ekibulamu; tebalina ku bulungi bw’obutukuvu wadde ku maanyi g’Omwoyo wa Katonda. Eyo ye mbeera y’Abakkolinso ab’omubiri, eyayogerwako eri Abaebbulaniya: “Newaakubadde nga kaakano mwandibadde musobola okuyigiriza abalala, kyetaaga okuddamu okubayigiriza, ebintu ebya bulijjo eby’amazima ebikwata ku kigambo kya Katonda. Mwetaaga mata so si mmere enkalubo ey’abakulu.” Abaebbulaniya 5:12. Si kya nnaku okulaba omukkiriza eyakyuka emyaka etaano, kkumi, abiri, naye nga talina w’akuze, talina maanyi, era talina ssanyu lya butukuvu?

Omwana omuto amanyibwa ku bubonero ki? Akamu kwe kuba nti omwana omuto tayinza kweyamba, naye bulijjo akwatirira abalala okumuweereza. Omwana omuwere mu nnyumba emirundi mingi aba ng’omufuzi omukambwe! Nnyina tayinza kufuluma, wateekwa okubaawo omukozi amulera; ateekwa okulabirirwa buli kiseera. Katonda yatonda omuntu okulabirira abalala, naye omwana omuwere yatondebwa okulabirirwa n’okuyambibwa. Bwe batyo waliwo Abakristaayo bulijjo abeetaaga okuyambibwa. Omusumba waabwe ne mikwano gyabwe Abakristaayo bateekwa bulijjo okubayigiriza n’okubabudaabuda. Bagenda mu kkanisa, ne mu nkuŋŋaana ez’okusaba, ne mu nkuŋŋaana ennene, bulijjo nga baagala okuyambibwa,—kabonero ka buwere bw’omwoyo.

Akabonero akalala ak’omwana omuwere kye kino: tayinza kukola kintu kyonna kuyamba munne. Buli muntu asuubirwa okuyamba ku bulungi bw’abantu; buli muntu alina ekifo ky’ateekwa okujjuza n’omulimu gw’ateekwa okukola, naye omwana omuwere tayinza kukolera bantu kintu kyonna. Bwe kiri ne ku Bakristaayo. Abamu nga bakola kitono nnyo! Beetaba mu mulimu, nga bwe guyitibwa, naye mu bo mulimu kitono eky’okukozesa amaanyi ag’omwoyo n’okutwala omukisa ogwa ddala. Buli omu ku ffe tasaanidde kwebuuza nti, “Mmaze okuva mu buwere bwange obw’omwoyo?” Abamu bateekwa okuddamu nti, “Nedda, mu kifo ky’okugenda mu maaso, nzizeeyo emabega, n’essanyu ery’okukyuka n’okwagala okwasooka bigenze.” Woowe! Baana bawere mu Kristo; bakyali ba mubiri.

Akabonero ak’okubiri ak’embeera ey’omubiri kye kino: waliwo ekibi n’okulemererwa buli kiseera. Pawulo agamba nti: “Kubanga mukyafugibwa mubiri. Naye obanga mukyalimu obuggya n’ennyombo, temufugibwa mubiri era temutambula ng’abalina empisa z’abantu obuntu?” 1 Abakkolinso 3:3.

Omuntu yeeleka n’asunguwala. Ayinza okuba omuweereza w’ekkanisa, oba omubuulizi w’Enjiri, oba omusomesa w’essomero lya Ssande, omunyiikivu ennyo mu lukuŋŋaana olw’okusaba, naye emirundi mingi alaga ennyombo oba obukyayi oba obuggya. Woowe! Woowe! Mu Abaggalatiya 3:5 tubuulirwa nti ebikolwa by’omubiri okusingira ddala bwe bulabe n’obuggya. Emirundi emeka mu Bakristaayo abateekwa okukolera awamu, gye tulaba enjawukana n’obukyayi? Katonda abasaasire, kubanga ebibala by’Omwoyo, kwe kwagala, emirundi mingi tebiri mu bantu be ye kennyini.

Obuuza nti, “Lwaki emyaka abiri nnwanagana n’obusungu bwange, naye ne siyinza kubuwangula?” Kiri bwe kityo kubanga obadde olwanagana n’obusungu, so tolwanyisa kikolo ky’obusungu.

Tolabanga nti byonna biva ku kuba nti oli mu mbeera ey’omubiri, era nti teweewaayo bulungi eri Omwoyo wa Katonda. Oboolyawo tewayigirizibwanga ekyo; tewakirabanga mu Kigambo kya Katonda; tewakikkirizanga.

Naye bwe kiri; amazima ga Katonda tegakyuka.

Yesu Kristo ayinza okutuwa obuwanguzi ku kibi, era ayinza okutukuuma obutakola kyonoono kya ddala. Sikugamba nti ekikolo ky’ekibi kirisimbulwa, era nti tolibeera na kisikirizo kya butonde kya kwonoona, naye Omwoyo Omutukuvu bw’ajja, si na maanyi ge ag’obuweereza ng’ekirabo kyokka, wabula bw’ajja mu kisa kya Katonda okujjuza omutima, wabaawo obuwanguzi ku kibi; amaanyi obutatuukiriza kwegomba kwa mubiri. Era embeera ey’omubiri ogiraba si mu butaagala, okwerowoozaako, n’obukyayi byokka, naye ne mu bibi ebirala bingi. Okwagala ensi nga kungi, okwegomba ebitiibwa nga kungi mu bantu, okunoonya okusiimibwa abantu nga kungi—byonna bibala bya bulamu bwa mubiri—ebisangibwa wakati mu mirimu gy’Ekikristaayo! Ka tujjukire nti embeera ey’omubiri mbeera ya kwonoona n’okulemererwa buli kiseera, era Katonda tayagala twatule bibi kinnakimu byokka, naye tutuuke n’okukkiriza nti bwe bubonero nti tetuli mu bulamu obulamu obulungi, tukyali ba mubiri.

Akabonero ak’okusatu, akanaannyonnyola ebisingawo ku bye mbadde njogera, kwe kuba nti embeera eno ey’omubiri eyinza okusangibwa ng’eri wamu n’ebirabo eby’omwoyo ebinene. Ebirabo n’ebisa bya njawulo. Ebisa by’Omwoyo bwe buwombeefu n’okwagala, ng’obuwombeefu n’okwagala kwa Kristo.

Ebisa by’Omwoyo bya kufuula muntu wa ddembe okuva mu bwannakyemalira; ebirabo by’Omwoyo bya kuteekateeka muntu okukola omulimu. Kino tukiraba mu Bakkolinso. Mu ssuula esooka, Pawulo agamba nti, “Nneebaza Katonda wange bulijjo ku lwammwe, olw’ekisa kya Katonda ekyabaweebwa mu Kristo Yesu, mu ye mwagaggawazibwa mu buli kintu, ne mu kwogera kwonna, era ne mu kutegeera kwonna” 1 Abakkolinso 1:4-5.

Mu ssuula ey’ekkumi n’ebbiri n’ey’ekkumi n’ennya, tulaba nti ebirabo eby’obunnabbi n’eby’okukola eby’amagero byali n’amaanyi mangi mu bo; naye ebisa by’Omwoyo nga tebirabika. Era kino kiyinza okubaawo mu biseera byaffe nga bwe kyali mu biseera by’Abakkolinso. Nnyinza okuba omuweereza w’Enjiri; nnyinza okuyigiriza Ekigambo kya Katonda mu ngeri ennungi, ne mba n’obuyinza ku bantu, ne nkuŋŋaanya ekibiina ekinene, naye, woowe! ne mba omuntu ow’omubiri; omuntu Katonda gw’ayinza okukozesa, era ayinza okuba omukisa eri abalala, naye nga obulamu obw’omubiri bukyamulimu.

Mwenna mumanyi etteeka nti ekintu kiyitibwa erinnya okusinziira ku ekyo ekisinga okukyeyoleka. Kale mu Bakkolinso bano ab’omubiri, mwalimu ku Mwoyo wa Katonda katono, naye omubiri gwe gwali gusinga; Omwoyo yali tafuga bulamu bwabwe bwonna. N’abantu ab’omwoyo tebayitibwa bwe batyo kubanga mu bo temuli mubiri, wabula kubanga Omwoyo mu bo afuuse nnannyini buyinza, era bw’obasisinkana n’ofuna enkolagana nabo, owulira nti Omwoyo wa Katonda abatukuzza. Ai, ka twekuume omukisa Katonda gw’atuwa mu mulimu gwaffe guleme kutulimba n’okutuleetera okulowooza nti olw’okuba atuwadde omukisa, tuteekwa okuba abantu ab’omwoyo. Katonda ayinza okutuwa ebirabo bye tukozesa, naye obulamu bwaffe ne butaba bwonna mu maanyi g’Omwoyo Omutukuvu.

Akabonero kange akasembayo ak’embeera ey’omubiri kwe kuba nti efuula omuntu obutasaanira kutoola mazima ga mwoyo. Ekyo omutume ky’awandiikira Abakkolinso: “Nabanywesa mata so si mmere enkalubo, kubanga mwali temunnagisobola. Naye era ne kaakano temunnagisobola” 1 Abakkolinso 3:2. Mu kkanisa tulina ekibiina ky’abantu ng’abasinga obungi bantu ba mubiri. Abantu bano tubawa okuyigiriza okw’omwoyo, ne bakwewuunya, ne bakutegeera, ne basanyukira obuweereza obwo, naye obulamu bwabwe ne butakyuka mu bikolwa. Bakolera Kristo mu ngeri emu, naye kizibu okulaba okutukuzibwa okwa ddala okw’Omwoyo; tetuyinza kugamba nti bantu ba mwoyo, abajjudde Omwoyo Omutukuvu.

Kale ka tukitegeere kino ku ffe ffennyini. Omuntu ayinza okuba omunyiikivu ennyo, n’atoola okuyigiriza kwonna kw’awulira; ayinza okuba ng’asobola okwawula, kubanga okwawula kirabo; ayinza okugamba nti, “Omusajja oyo annyamba mu nsonga eno, n’oli mu ndala, n’ow’okusatu amanyiddwa olw’ekirabo ekirala;” naye ekiseera kyonna obulamu obw’omubiri ne bubeera bulamu nnyo mu ye, era bw’agwa mu buzibu ne mukwano gwe, oba n’omukozi Omukristaayo, oba n’omuntu ow’ensi, ekikolo eky’omubiri kibala ekibala kyakyo eky’entiisa, era emmere ey’omwoyo eremereddwa okuyingira mu mutima gwe.

Mwekuume ekyo. Mutunuulire Abakkolinso muyigire ku bo. Pawulo teyabagamba nti, “Temuyinza kugumira mazima nga bwe nandyagadde okugabategeeza,” kubanga baali bantu abatamanyi oba abasirusiru.

Embeera ey’omubiri tugisanga si mu Kkolinso mwokka, naye mu nsi yonna ey’Ekikristaayo leero. Abakristaayo bangi babuuza nti, “Lwaki mu Kkanisa mulimu obunafu bungi bwe butyo?” Ekibuuzo kino tetuyinza kukibuuza na bunyiikivu busukkiridde, era nsuubira nti Katonda yennyini alikinyweeza mu mitima gyaffe ne tumugamba nti, “Kiteekwa okukyuka. Tusaasire.” Naye, ai! Okusaba okwo n’enkyukakyuka eyo tebiyinza kujja okutuusa nga tutandise okulaba nti waliwo ekikolo eky’omubiri ekifuga mu bakkiriza; batambulira nnyo mu mubiri okusinga mu Mwoyo; Bakristaayo ba mubiri.

Waliwo okusomoka “okuva mu mubiri okutuuka mu mwoyo.” Pawulo yasanga abakkiriza ab’omwoyo? Awatali kubuusabuusa yabasanga. Soma busomi essuula ey’omukaaga ey’Ebbaluwa eri Abaggalatiya! Eyo yali kkanisa ennyombo, obukyayi n’obuggya gye byali eby’entiisa. Naye omutume agamba mu lunyiriri olusooka nti: “Abooluganda omuntu bw’abanga alina ekibi ky’akoze, mmwe ab’omwoyo mumuluŋŋamyenga mu buwombeefu nga mwegendereza si kulwa nga nammwe mugwa mu kukemebwa.”

Abaggalatiya 6:1.

Awo tulaba nti obubonero bw’omuntu ow’omwoyo bwe buno: aliba muteefu; era aliba n’amaanyi, n’okwagala okuyamba n’okuzzaawo abo abagudde. Omuntu ow’omubiri tayinza kukola ekyo. Bwe wabaawo obulamu obw’omwoyo obwa ddala obuyinza okubeerwamu, ekibuuzo ekinene kiri nti: Ekkubo liggule, era nnyinza ntya okuyingira mu mbeera ey’omwoyo? Wano nate nnina okuddamu kuna okumpi.

Ekisooka, tuteekwa okumanya nti waliwo obulamu obw’omwoyo ng’obwo abantu bwe bayinza okubeeramu ku nsi. Tewali kintu kisala bikolo bya bulamu bwa Kikristaayo nga obutakkiriza. Abantu tebakkiriza Katonda by’ayogedde ku by’ayagala okukolera abaana be. Abantu tebakkiriza nti Katonda bw’agamba nti, “Omwoyo ajjulenga mu bulamu bwammwe,” ekyo akigendereza eri buli Mukristaayo. Naye Pawulo yawandiikira Abaefeso ng’agamba nti: “Ate temutamiiranga, kubanga mujja kweyonoona, wabula Omwoyo ajjulenga mu bulamu bwammwe,” Abaefeso 5:18. Nga bwe kitakugwanira kutamiira wayini, bw’atyo bwe kitakugwanira kubeera mulamu nga tojjudde Mwoyo. Kale, Katonda bw’aba ng’ekyo akigendereza eri abakkiriza, ekintu ekisooka kye twetaaga kwe kuyiga n’okutwala Ekigambo kya Katonda ku mutima, okutuusa emitima gyaffe lwe gijjula obukakafu nti obulamu ng’obwo busoboka, era nti kye kitugwanira okubeeramu; nti tuyinza okuba abantu ab’omwoyo. Ekigambo kya Katonda kituyigiriza nti Katonda tasuubira muntu kubeera nga bw’asaanidde wadde edakiika emu, okuggyako nga Omwoyo Omutukuvu ali mu ye okumusobozesa okukikola.

Tetwetaaga Mwoyo Mutukuvu lwokka nga tugenda kubuulira, oba nga tulina okugumira okukemebwa okw’enjawulo okwa Setaani, oba omugugu omunene okwetikka; Katonda agamba nti: “Omwana wange tayinza kubeera mu bulamu obutuufu okuggyako ng’akulemberwa Omwoyo wange buli dakiika.” Ako ke kabonero k’omwana wa Katonda: “kubanga abo bonna abakulemberwa Omwoyo wa Katonda be baana ba Katonda.” Abaruumi 8:14. Mu Abaruumi 5 tusoma nti: “kubanga Katonda atuwadde Mwoyo Mutukuvu ajjuza emitima gyaffe okwagala kwe.” Abaruumi 5:5. Ekyo kye kiteekwa okuba ekintu eky’abulijjo, ekya buli lunaku, omukkiriza ky’ayitamu; so si bulamu bwe mu biseera ebyateekebwawo byokka. Kitaawe w’omwana oba nnyina yali alowoozezza nti, “Leero lwokka njagala omwana wange anjagale?” Nedda, basuubira okwagala buli lunaku. Bw’atyo Katonda ayagala omwana we buli kaseera abeere n’omutima ogujjudde okwagala kw’Omwoyo. Mu maaso ga Katonda, kintu ekitali kya butonde n’akatono okusuubira omuntu okwagala nga bw’asaanidde nga tajjudde Mwoyo.

Ai, ka tukkirize nti omuntu ayinza okuba omuntu ow’omwoyo. Katonda yeebazibwe, waliwo kaakano omukisa ogutulindiridde. “Omwoyo ajjulenga mu bulamu bwammwe.” “Mukulemberwenga Omwoyo.” Ogwo gwe mukisa. Bw’oba olina okugamba nti, “Ai, Katonda, sirina mukisa guno,” kyogere; naye era yogera nti, “Mukama, mmanyi nti kye kingwanidde, buvunaanyizibwa bwange obw’amaanyi okugufuna, kubanga awatali gwo siyinza kubeera mu mirembe egituukiridde naawe olunaku lwonna; awatali gwo siyinza kukugulumiza n’okukola omulimu gw’oyagala nkole.”

Eryo lye ddaala lyaffe erisooka okuva mu mubiri okutuuka mu mwoyo: okukkiriza nti obulamu obw’omwoyo, okutambulira mu Mwoyo, tusobola okubutuukako.

Tuyinza tutya okusaba Katonda atukulembere mu bulamu obw’omwoyo, nga tetulina bukakafu bulambulukufu era obunywevu nti waliwo obulamu ng’obwo obuyinza okufunibwa?

Awo ne wajja eddaala ery’okubiri; omuntu ateekwa okulaba ensonyi n’omusango gw’okuba nti abadde mu bulamu ng’obwo. Abantu abamu bakkiriza nti waliwo obulamu obw’omwoyo obw’okubeeramu, era nti tebabubaddemu, ne beesaasira, ne beekwatirwa ekisa, ne balowooza nti, “Nga kya nnaku okuba nti ndi munafu nnyo okubufuna! Nga kya nnaku nti Katonda abuwa abalala, naye nze tabumpadde!” Beesaasira nnyo, mu kifo ky’okugamba nti, “Woowe! Obutaba beesigwa bwaffe, obutakkiriza bwaffe, n’obujeemu bwaffe bye bitulobedde okwewaayo ddala eri Katonda. Tuteekwa okukwatibwa ensonyi mu maaso ga Katonda olw’okuba nti tetubeera ng’abantu ab’omwoyo.” Omuntu tayinza kukyuka nga tannakakasibwa kibi kye. Okukakasibwa okwo bwe kujja, amaaso ge ne gazibuka, ayiga okutya ekibi kye, n’akiddukako n’agenda eri Kristo, n’akkiriza Kristo ng’Omununuzi ow’amaanyi. Naye omuntu yeetaaga okukakasibwa ekibi omulundi ogwokubiri; omukkiriza ateekwa okukakasibwa ekibi kye eky’enjawulo. Ebibi by’omuntu atannakyuka byawukana ku bibi by’omukkiriza.

Ng’ekyokulabirako, omuntu atannakyuka emirundi mingi tafuna kukakasibwa kwonooneka kwa butonde bwe; okusingira ddala alowooza ku bibi eby’okungulu: “Ndayidde, mbadde mulimba, era ndi mu kkubo erigenda mu ggeyeena.” Olwo n’akakasibwa n’akyuka. Naye omukkiriza ali mu mbeera ya njawulo ddala. Ebibi bye bisingako nnyo okuba eby’omusango, kubanga yaweebwa ekitangaala n’okwagala n’Omwoyo wa Katonda. Ebibi bye bisingako nnyo obuziba. Afubye okubiwangula, era akuze okulaba nti obutonde bwe bwonoonefu ddala, nti endowooza ey’omubiri, omubiri oguli mu ye, gufuula embeera ye yonna eya nnaku ddala.

Omukkiriza bw’akakasibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu, okusingira ddala obulamu bwe obw’obutakkiriza bwe bumusalira omusango, kubanga alaba nti omusango omunene ogukwatagana nabwo gwe gumulobedde okufuna ekirabo ekijjuvu eky’Omwoyo Omutukuvu owa Katonda. Akkakkanyizibwa mu nsonyi n’okutabulwa mu maaso, n’atandika okukaaba nti: “Amatu gange gaali gaakuwulirako dda, naye kaakano amaaso gange gakulabye.” Yobu 42:5. Katonda amusemberera. Yobu, omuntu omutuukirivu, Katonda gwe yeesiga, yalaba mu ye ekibi eky’amaanyi eky’obwannakyemalira n’obutuukirivu bwakyo, kye yali tannalabangako. Okutuusa okukakasibwa kuno okw’obubi bw’embeera yaffe ey’omubiri ng’abakkiriza lwe kujja ku buli omu ku ffe; okutuusa nga twagala okufuna okukakasibwa kuno okuva eri Katonda, okumala ekiseera mu maaso ga Katonda nga tukkakkanyizibwa era nga tukakasibwa, tetuyinza kufuuka bantu ba mwoyo.

Awo ne wajja akabonero ak’okusatu, kwe kuba nti okuva mu mbeera ey’omubiri okutuuka mu mbeera ey’omwoyo ddaala limu lyokka. Eddaala limu; ai, obwo bubaka bwa mukisa bwe mbaleetedde—ddaala limu lyokka. Mmanyi nti abantu bangi bajja kugaana okukkiriza nti ddaala limu lyokka; balowooza nti kitono nnyo olw’enkyukakyuka ennene bwe etyo. Naye okukyuka tekwali ddaala limu lyokka?

Bwe kiri bwe kityo omuntu bw’ava mu mubiri n’ayingira mu mwoyo. Obuuza oba nga bwe njogera ku muntu ow’omwoyo, sirowooza ku muntu eyakula mu by’omwoyo, omutukuvu owa ddala, n’ogamba nti: “Ekyo kijja mu lunaku lumu? Tewali kukula mu butukuvu?” Nkuddamu nti okukula mu by’omwoyo tekuyinza kujja mu lunaku lumu. Tetuyinza kukisuubira.

Kyetaagisa okukula okutuusa obulungi bwonna obw’ekifaananyi kya Kristo lwe bukolebwa mu muntu. Naye era nkyagamba nti omuntu yeetaaga eddaala limu lyokka okuva mu bulamu obw’omubiri okuyingira mu bulamu obw’omwoyo. Kiba bwe kityo omuntu bw’akutula ddala n’omubiri; bw’awaayo omubiri eri okufa kwa Kristo okw’okukomererwa; bw’alaba nti buli kintu ekigukwatako kikolimire era nti tayinza kweggya mu gwo; n’alyoka yeeyuna amaanyi g’omusaalaba gwa Kristo agatta mu ye,—omuntu bw’akola ekyo n’agamba nti: “Obulamu buno obw’omwoyo obwanteekerwateekerwa kirabo kya bwereere okuva eri Katonda wange mu Kristo Yesu,” n’alyoka ategeera engeri eddaala limu gye liyinza okumuggya mu mbeera ey’omubiri ne limuyingiza mu ey’omwoyo. Mu bulamu obwo obw’omwoyo, wajja kubaayo bingi ebikyali eby’okuyiga.

Omuntu bw’amala okwewaayo eri amaanyi ag’Omwoyo wa Katonda aga ddala, amalamu, agakola, era agafuga, aba atuuse mu kifo ekituufu mw’asobola okukulira. Tolowoozangako kukula ng’ova mu bulwadde n’oyingira mu bulamu obulungi; oyinza okukula ng’ova mu bunafu n’ogenda mu maanyi, ng’omwana omuwere bw’ayinza okukula n’afuuka omusajja ow’amaanyi; naye awali obulwadde, wateekwa okubaawo okuwonyezebwa bwe kuba nga ddala anaawona.

Pawulo agamba nti obulamu obw’omubiri buteekwa okusalibwako. “N’abo aba Kristo Yesu baakomerera omubiri n’okwegomba kwagwo, n’omululu gwagwo.” Abaruumi 5:24. Omuntu bw’ategeera ekyo kye kitegeeza, n’akikkiriza mu kukkiriza kw’ebyo Kristo by’ayinza okukola, olwo eddaala limu liyinza okumuggya mu mubiri ne limutuusa mu mwoyo. Ekikolwa ekimu ekyangu eky’okukkiriza mu maanyi g’okufa kwa Kristo, ekikolwa ekimu eky’okwewaayo eri okussa ekimu mu kufa kwa Kristo nga Omwoyo Omutukuvu bw’ayinza okukufuula okwaffe, kujja kukufuula okwaffe, era kujja kukuleetera okununulibwa okuva mu buyinza bw’okufuba kwo.

Kiki ekyaleetera okununulibwa omwonoonyi oli omwavu eyasalirwa omusango, eyali mu kizikiza ekingi era mu nnaku ennyingi mu mbeera ye ey’obutakyuka? Yawulira nti tayinza kwekolera kirungi kyonna. Yakola ki? Yalaba mu maaso ge Omulokozi ow’obuyinza bwonna, ne yeesuula mu mikono gye; ne yeeteeka mu kwagala okwo okw’obuyinza bwonna, n’akaaba nti, “Mukama, onsaasire.” Obwo bwe bwali obulokozi. Kristo teyamukkiriza lwa ekyo kye yakola. Mmwe abakkiriza, bwe wabaawo ku ffe amanyi nti embeera ey’omubiri y’esinga mu ye, n’ateekwa okugamba nti: “Kino kinkwatako; ndi muntu wa ddiini, omuntu omunyiikivu, mukwano gw’emirimu gy’obuminsani; nkolera Kristo mu kkanisa yange, naye, woowe! obusungu n’ekibi n’okwagala ensi bikyafuga emmeeme yange,” wulira ekigambo kya Katonda. Bwe wabaawo anajja n’agamba nti: “Nfubye, nsabye, nkaabye, naye tekinnyambye,” olwo oteekwa okukola ekintu ekirala kimu.

Oteekwa okulaba nti Kristo omulamu ye Katonda gw’akuteekeddewo olw’obulamu bwo obutukuvu era obw’omwoyo. Oteekwa okukkiriza nti Kristo oyo eyakukkiriza edda, ng’okyuka, mu kwagala kwe okw’ekitalo, kaakano akulindiridde okukugamba nti oyinza okufuuka omuntu ow’omwoyo, eyeewaddeyo ddala eri Katonda. Bw’okkiriza ekyo, okutya kwo kujja kuggwaawo era ojja kugamba nti: “Kisoboka; Kristo bw’anakkiriza n’akivunaanyizibwa, kijja kukolebwa.”

Kaakano akabonero kange akasembayo. Omuntu ateekwa okulinnya eddaala eryo, eddaala ery’amaanyi naye ery’omukisa. Abamu ku mmwe kyabatwalira emyaka etaano oba kkumi okulinnya eddaala ery’okukyuka. Mwakaaba ne musaba okumala emyaka, ne mutafuna mirembe okutuusa lwe mwalinnya eddaala eryo. Bwe kityo, ne mu bulamu obw’omwoyo, oyinza okugenda eri omusomesa omu ne oli, n’ogamba nti, “Mbuulira ku bulamu obw’omwoyo, ku kubatizibwa kw’Omwoyo, ne ku butukuvu,” naye n’osigala nga bwe wali. Bangi ku ffe twandyagadde ekibi kiggyibweko. Ani ayagala okuba n’obusungu obw’amangu? Ani ayagala okuba n’emmeeme ey’amalala? Ani ayagala okuba n’omutima ogw’ensi? Tewali n’omu.

Tugenda eri Kristo akiggyewo, n’atakikola, ne tubuuza nti, “Lwaki takikola? Nsabye n’obunyiikivu bungi.” Kiri bwe kityo kubanga wayagala aggyewo ebibala ebibi nga ekikolo eky’obutwa kisigala mu ggwe. Tewamusaba nti omubiri gukomererwe ku musaalaba gwe, era nti okuva olwo weewaayo ddala eri amaanyi g’Omwoyo we. Okununulibwa kuliwo, naye si mu ngeri gye tukunoonyamu. Teebereza omusiizi w’ebifaananyi alina olugoye lw’okusiigako, ng’ayagala okukolerako ekifaananyi ekirungi. Teebereza olugoye olwo si lulwe, era buli muntu alina eddembe okulutwala n’alukozesa ku kigendererwa ekirala kyonna; olowooza omusiizi oyo yandiruteekeddeko omulimu mungi? Nedda. Naye abantu baagala Yesu Kristo yeeteeke mu buzibu ku lwabwe ng’abaggyako obusungu buno oba ekibi ekirala kiri, so nga mu mitima gyabwe tebeewaddeyo ddala eri okulagira kwe n’okukuuma kwe. Tekiyinza kubaawo. Naye bw’onoojja n’owaayo obulamu bwo bwonna mu mikono gye, Kristo Yesu wa maanyi okulokola; Kristo Yesu alindirira okuba ow’ekisa; Kristo Yesu alindirira okukujjuza Omwoyo we.

Tolinnye ddaala eryo? Katonda atuwe ekyo, tukulemberwe Omwoyo we okwewaayo gy’ali nga bwe tutakolangako. Tojja mu kwatula okw’obuwombeefu? Woowe! Obulamu obw’omubiri bwasukkiridde okufuga, bukufuze ddala, era olina okuwulira okukaawa nti wadde Katonda akuwadde emikisa gyonna egyo, takufudde ky’oyagala okuba—omuntu ow’omwoyo? Omwoyo Omutukuvu yekka, ng’abeera mu ggwe, y’ayinza okufuula omuntu ow’omwoyo. Kale jjangu weesuule ku bigere bya Katonda, n’ekirowoozo kino kimu, “Mukama, neewaayo gy’oli ng’ekibya ekyereere okujjuzibwa Omwoyo wo.”

Buli omu ku mmwe buli lunaku alaba ku mmeeza ya caayi ekikopo ekyereere nga kiteekeddwawo, nga kirindirira okujjuzibwamu caayi ekiseera ekituufu bwe kituuka. Bwe kiri ne ku buli kibya, na buli sowaani: biyonjebwa ne bifuukulwa, nga byetegefu okujjuzibwa.

Nga bifuukuddwa era nga biyonjeddwa.

Ai, jjangu! Era ng’ekibya bwe kiwulwa okutoola ekyo kye kigenda okubaamu, gamba Kristo nti okuva mu ssaawa eno oyagala okuba ekibya ekyawuliddwa okujjuzibwa Omwoyo we, ng’oweereddwayo okuba omuntu ow’omwoyo. Vunnama mu bwereere obusingayo obuziba obw’emmeeme yo, ogambe nti, “Ai, Katonda, sirina kintu!” era olwo, mazima ddala, bwe weeteeka mu maaso ge, olina eddembe okugamba nti, “Katonda wange ajja kutuukiriza ekisuubizo kye!

Mmusaba anzijuze Omwoyo Omutukuvu, anfuule Omukristaayo ow’omwoyo mu kifo ky’ow’omubiri.” Bw’oneeteeka ku bigere bye n’olindirira awo; bw’onoobeera mu kwewaayo okwo okw’obuwombeefu n’okwesiga okwo okw’omwana omuto, nga Katonda bw’ali omulamu, omukisa gujja kujja.

Ai, tetuteekwa kuvunnama mu nsonyi mu maaso ga Katonda, bwe tulowooza ku Kkanisa ye yonna ne tulaba nga ebyomubiri bingi bwe bifuga? Tetuteekwa kuvunnama mu nsonyi mu maaso ga Katonda, bwe tulowooza ku bya mubiri ebingi ennyo mu mitima gyaffe ne mu bulamu bwaffe?

Kale ka tuvunname n’okukkiriza okungi mu kusaasira kwa Katonda. Okununulibwa kuli kumpi, okununulibwa kujja, okununulibwa kulindiridde, okununulibwa kukakafu. Ka twesige; Katonda ajja kukutuwa.
fields.body_text: “Nange abooluganda ssaasobola kwogera nammwe ng’ab’omwoyo, naye nayogera nammwe ng’ab’omubiri” 1 Abakkolinso 3:1. Wano omutume Pawulo ayogera ku mitendera ebiri egy’obulamu bw’Ekikristaayo, ku bika bibiri eby’Abakristaayo: “ssaasobola kwogera nammwe ng’ab’omwoyo, naye nayogera nammwe ng’ab’omubiri era ng’abaana abawere mu Kristo.” 1 Abakkolinso 3:1. Baali Bakristaayo, nga bali mu Kristo, naye mu kifo ky’okuba Abakristaayo ab’omwoyo, baali ba mubiri. “Nabanywesa mata so si mmere enkalubo, kubanga mwali temunnagisobola. Naye era ne kaakano temunnagisobola, kubanga mukyafugibwa mubiri.” 1 Abakkolinso 1:2-3 Wano ekigambo ekyo kiddamu omulundi ogwokubiri. “Naye obanga”—buno bwe bukakafu—“mukyalimu obuggya n’ennyombo, temufugibwa mubiri era temutambula ng’abalina empisa z’abantu obuntu? Kubanga omuntu yenna bw’agamba nti, Nze ndi wa Pawulo, n’omulala nti, Nze ndi wa Apolo, olwo temuba ng’abantu obuntu?” 1 Abakkolinso 3:2-4. Emirundi ena omutume alaga nti abantu abo ba mubiri. Mu magezi Omwoyo Omutukuvu ge yamuwa, Pawulo awulira nti: Siyinza kuwandiikira Bakristaayo bano ab’e Kkolinso okuggyako nga mmanyi embeera yaabwe, era nga ngibabuulira. Bwe mpa emmere ey’omwoyo abo Abakristaayo ab’omubiri, mbakola kabi okusinga obulungi, kubanga tebasobola kugirya. Siyinza kubaliisa mmere enkalubo; nteekwa okubanywesa amata. Bw’atyo, ku ntandikwa y’ebbaluwa yennyini, abategeeza embeera yaabwe nga bw’agiraba. Mu ssuula ebbiri ezisooka, Pawulo yali ayogedde ku buweereza bwe nga bwa Mwoyo Omutukuvu; kaakano atandika okubategeeza embeera abantu gye bateekwa okubaamu basobole okutoola amazima ag’omwoyo, era agamba nti: “Siyinza kwogera nammwe nga bwe nandyagadde, kubanga muli ba mubiri, era temusobola kutoola mazima ga mwoyo.” 1 Abakkolinso 3:1. Ekyo kituleetera ekirowoozo eky’amaanyi nti mu Kkanisa ya Kristo mulimu ebibiina bibiri eby’Abakristaayo. Abamu bamaze emyaka mingi nga bakkiriza, naye bulijjo basigala bawere; abalala bantu ba mwoyo kubanga beewaddeyo eri amaanyi, n’obukulembeze, n’obufuzi bwonna obw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Bwe tuba ab’okufuna omukisa, tusooke tusalewo kibiina ki ku bino kye tulimu. Ku bw’ekisa kya Katonda, tuli mu bulamu obw’omwoyo mu buwombeefu obungi, oba tuli mu bulamu obw’omubiri? Kale ka tusooke tugezeeko okutegeera ekitegeezebwa embeera ey’omubiri abakkiriza gye bayinza okubeeramu. Okuva ku bye tusanga mu Abakkolinso, tulaba obubonero buna obw’embeera ey’omubiri. Ekisooka: bwe buwere obulwawo ennyo. Mumanyi ekyo kye kitegeeza. Teebereza omwana omulungi ow’emyezi mukaaga. Tayinza kwogera, tayinza kutambula, naye ekyo tekitweraliikiriza; kya butonde, era bwe kiteekwa okuba. Naye teebereza nga wayise omwaka ne tusanga omwana talina w’akuze n’akatono, ate oluvannyuma lw’emyaka esatu nga tannakula; amangu ago twandigambye nti: “Wateekwa okubaawo obulwadde obw’entiisa;” n’omwana oyo eyali essanyu eri buli eyamulabanga ng’alina emyezi mukaaga, afuuse eri nnyina n’eri bonna ensibuko y’okweraliikirira n’ennaku. Waliwo ekitali kituufu; omwana tayinza kukula. Kyali kituufu ddala nti ku myezi mukaaga alye amata gokka, naye emyaka giyiseewo, era akyali munafu nga bwe yali. Kale eyo y’embeera y’abakkiriza bangi. Bakyuse; bamanyi kye kitegeeza okuba abakakafu n’okuba n’okukkiriza; bakkiriza okusonyiyibwa ebibi; batandika okukolera Katonda; naye mu ngeri emu oba endala, tebakula nnyo mu by’omwoyo, mu bulamu obwa ddala obw’omu ggulu. Bwe tusisinkana nabo, amangu ago tuwulira nti waliwo ekibulamu; tebalina ku bulungi bw’obutukuvu wadde ku maanyi g’Omwoyo wa Katonda. Eyo ye mbeera y’Abakkolinso ab’omubiri, eyayogerwako eri Abaebbulaniya: “Newaakubadde nga kaakano mwandibadde musobola okuyigiriza abalala, kyetaaga okuddamu okubayigiriza, ebintu ebya bulijjo eby’amazima ebikwata ku kigambo kya Katonda. Mwetaaga mata so si mmere enkalubo ey’abakulu.” Abaebbulaniya 5:12. Si kya nnaku okulaba omukkiriza eyakyuka emyaka etaano, kkumi, abiri, naye nga talina w’akuze, talina maanyi, era talina ssanyu lya butukuvu? Omwana omuto amanyibwa ku bubonero ki? Akamu kwe kuba nti omwana omuto tayinza kweyamba, naye bulijjo akwatirira abalala okumuweereza. Omwana omuwere mu nnyumba emirundi mingi aba ng’omufuzi omukambwe! Nnyina tayinza kufuluma, wateekwa okubaawo omukozi amulera; ateekwa okulabirirwa buli kiseera. Katonda yatonda omuntu okulabirira abalala, naye omwana omuwere yatondebwa okulabirirwa n’okuyambibwa. Bwe batyo waliwo Abakristaayo bulijjo abeetaaga okuyambibwa. Omusumba waabwe ne mikwano gyabwe Abakristaayo bateekwa bulijjo okubayigiriza n’okubabudaabuda. Bagenda mu kkanisa, ne mu nkuŋŋaana ez’okusaba, ne mu nkuŋŋaana ennene, bulijjo nga baagala okuyambibwa,—kabonero ka buwere bw’omwoyo. Akabonero akalala ak’omwana omuwere kye kino: tayinza kukola kintu kyonna kuyamba munne. Buli muntu asuubirwa okuyamba ku bulungi bw’abantu; buli muntu alina ekifo ky’ateekwa okujjuza n’omulimu gw’ateekwa okukola, naye omwana omuwere tayinza kukolera bantu kintu kyonna. Bwe kiri ne ku Bakristaayo. Abamu nga bakola kitono nnyo! Beetaba mu mulimu, nga bwe guyitibwa, naye mu bo mulimu kitono eky’okukozesa amaanyi ag’omwoyo n’okutwala omukisa ogwa ddala. Buli omu ku ffe tasaanidde kwebuuza nti, “Mmaze okuva mu buwere bwange obw’omwoyo?” Abamu bateekwa okuddamu nti, “Nedda, mu kifo ky’okugenda mu maaso, nzizeeyo emabega, n’essanyu ery’okukyuka n’okwagala okwasooka bigenze.” Woowe! Baana bawere mu Kristo; bakyali ba mubiri. Akabonero ak’okubiri ak’embeera ey’omubiri kye kino: waliwo ekibi n’okulemererwa buli kiseera. Pawulo agamba nti: “Kubanga mukyafugibwa mubiri. Naye obanga mukyalimu obuggya n’ennyombo, temufugibwa mubiri era temutambula ng’abalina empisa z’abantu obuntu?” 1 Abakkolinso 3:3. Omuntu yeeleka n’asunguwala. Ayinza okuba omuweereza w’ekkanisa, oba omubuulizi w’Enjiri, oba omusomesa w’essomero lya Ssande, omunyiikivu ennyo mu lukuŋŋaana olw’okusaba, naye emirundi mingi alaga ennyombo oba obukyayi oba obuggya. Woowe! Woowe! Mu Abaggalatiya 3:5 tubuulirwa nti ebikolwa by’omubiri okusingira ddala bwe bulabe n’obuggya. Emirundi emeka mu Bakristaayo abateekwa okukolera awamu, gye tulaba enjawukana n’obukyayi? Katonda abasaasire, kubanga ebibala by’Omwoyo, kwe kwagala, emirundi mingi tebiri mu bantu be ye kennyini. Obuuza nti, “Lwaki emyaka abiri nnwanagana n’obusungu bwange, naye ne siyinza kubuwangula?” Kiri bwe kityo kubanga obadde olwanagana n’obusungu, so tolwanyisa kikolo ky’obusungu. Tolabanga nti byonna biva ku kuba nti oli mu mbeera ey’omubiri, era nti teweewaayo bulungi eri Omwoyo wa Katonda. Oboolyawo tewayigirizibwanga ekyo; tewakirabanga mu Kigambo kya Katonda; tewakikkirizanga. Naye bwe kiri; amazima ga Katonda tegakyuka. Yesu Kristo ayinza okutuwa obuwanguzi ku kibi, era ayinza okutukuuma obutakola kyonoono kya ddala. Sikugamba nti ekikolo ky’ekibi kirisimbulwa, era nti tolibeera na kisikirizo kya butonde kya kwonoona, naye Omwoyo Omutukuvu bw’ajja, si na maanyi ge ag’obuweereza ng’ekirabo kyokka, wabula bw’ajja mu kisa kya Katonda okujjuza omutima, wabaawo obuwanguzi ku kibi; amaanyi obutatuukiriza kwegomba kwa mubiri. Era embeera ey’omubiri ogiraba si mu butaagala, okwerowoozaako, n’obukyayi byokka, naye ne mu bibi ebirala bingi. Okwagala ensi nga kungi, okwegomba ebitiibwa nga kungi mu bantu, okunoonya okusiimibwa abantu nga kungi—byonna bibala bya bulamu bwa mubiri—ebisangibwa wakati mu mirimu gy’Ekikristaayo! Ka tujjukire nti embeera ey’omubiri mbeera ya kwonoona n’okulemererwa buli kiseera, era Katonda tayagala twatule bibi kinnakimu byokka, naye tutuuke n’okukkiriza nti bwe bubonero nti tetuli mu bulamu obulamu obulungi, tukyali ba mubiri. Akabonero ak’okusatu, akanaannyonnyola ebisingawo ku bye mbadde njogera, kwe kuba nti embeera eno ey’omubiri eyinza okusangibwa ng’eri wamu n’ebirabo eby’omwoyo ebinene. Ebirabo n’ebisa bya njawulo. Ebisa by’Omwoyo bwe buwombeefu n’okwagala, ng’obuwombeefu n’okwagala kwa Kristo. Ebisa by’Omwoyo bya kufuula muntu wa ddembe okuva mu bwannakyemalira; ebirabo by’Omwoyo bya kuteekateeka muntu okukola omulimu. Kino tukiraba mu Bakkolinso. Mu ssuula esooka, Pawulo agamba nti, “Nneebaza Katonda wange bulijjo ku lwammwe, olw’ekisa kya Katonda ekyabaweebwa mu Kristo Yesu, mu ye mwagaggawazibwa mu buli kintu, ne mu kwogera kwonna, era ne mu kutegeera kwonna” 1 Abakkolinso 1:4-5. Mu ssuula ey’ekkumi n’ebbiri n’ey’ekkumi n’ennya, tulaba nti ebirabo eby’obunnabbi n’eby’okukola eby’amagero byali n’amaanyi mangi mu bo; naye ebisa by’Omwoyo nga tebirabika. Era kino kiyinza okubaawo mu biseera byaffe nga bwe kyali mu biseera by’Abakkolinso. Nnyinza okuba omuweereza w’Enjiri; nnyinza okuyigiriza Ekigambo kya Katonda mu ngeri ennungi, ne mba n’obuyinza ku bantu, ne nkuŋŋaanya ekibiina ekinene, naye, woowe! ne mba omuntu ow’omubiri; omuntu Katonda gw’ayinza okukozesa, era ayinza okuba omukisa eri abalala, naye nga obulamu obw’omubiri bukyamulimu. Mwenna mumanyi etteeka nti ekintu kiyitibwa erinnya okusinziira ku ekyo ekisinga okukyeyoleka. Kale mu Bakkolinso bano ab’omubiri, mwalimu ku Mwoyo wa Katonda katono, naye omubiri gwe gwali gusinga; Omwoyo yali tafuga bulamu bwabwe bwonna. N’abantu ab’omwoyo tebayitibwa bwe batyo kubanga mu bo temuli mubiri, wabula kubanga Omwoyo mu bo afuuse nnannyini buyinza, era bw’obasisinkana n’ofuna enkolagana nabo, owulira nti Omwoyo wa Katonda abatukuzza. Ai, ka twekuume omukisa Katonda gw’atuwa mu mulimu gwaffe guleme kutulimba n’okutuleetera okulowooza nti olw’okuba atuwadde omukisa, tuteekwa okuba abantu ab’omwoyo. Katonda ayinza okutuwa ebirabo bye tukozesa, naye obulamu bwaffe ne butaba bwonna mu maanyi g’Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Akabonero kange akasembayo ak’embeera ey’omubiri kwe kuba nti efuula omuntu obutasaanira kutoola mazima ga mwoyo. Ekyo omutume ky’awandiikira Abakkolinso: “Nabanywesa mata so si mmere enkalubo, kubanga mwali temunnagisobola. Naye era ne kaakano temunnagisobola” 1 Abakkolinso 3:2. Mu kkanisa tulina ekibiina ky’abantu ng’abasinga obungi bantu ba mubiri. Abantu bano tubawa okuyigiriza okw’omwoyo, ne bakwewuunya, ne bakutegeera, ne basanyukira obuweereza obwo, naye obulamu bwabwe ne butakyuka mu bikolwa. Bakolera Kristo mu ngeri emu, naye kizibu okulaba okutukuzibwa okwa ddala okw’Omwoyo; tetuyinza kugamba nti bantu ba mwoyo, abajjudde Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Kale ka tukitegeere kino ku ffe ffennyini. Omuntu ayinza okuba omunyiikivu ennyo, n’atoola okuyigiriza kwonna kw’awulira; ayinza okuba ng’asobola okwawula, kubanga okwawula kirabo; ayinza okugamba nti, “Omusajja oyo annyamba mu nsonga eno, n’oli mu ndala, n’ow’okusatu amanyiddwa olw’ekirabo ekirala;” naye ekiseera kyonna obulamu obw’omubiri ne bubeera bulamu nnyo mu ye, era bw’agwa mu buzibu ne mukwano gwe, oba n’omukozi Omukristaayo, oba n’omuntu ow’ensi, ekikolo eky’omubiri kibala ekibala kyakyo eky’entiisa, era emmere ey’omwoyo eremereddwa okuyingira mu mutima gwe. Mwekuume ekyo. Mutunuulire Abakkolinso muyigire ku bo. Pawulo teyabagamba nti, “Temuyinza kugumira mazima nga bwe nandyagadde okugabategeeza,” kubanga baali bantu abatamanyi oba abasirusiru. Embeera ey’omubiri tugisanga si mu Kkolinso mwokka, naye mu nsi yonna ey’Ekikristaayo leero. Abakristaayo bangi babuuza nti, “Lwaki mu Kkanisa mulimu obunafu bungi bwe butyo?” Ekibuuzo kino tetuyinza kukibuuza na bunyiikivu busukkiridde, era nsuubira nti Katonda yennyini alikinyweeza mu mitima gyaffe ne tumugamba nti, “Kiteekwa okukyuka. Tusaasire.” Naye, ai! Okusaba okwo n’enkyukakyuka eyo tebiyinza kujja okutuusa nga tutandise okulaba nti waliwo ekikolo eky’omubiri ekifuga mu bakkiriza; batambulira nnyo mu mubiri okusinga mu Mwoyo; Bakristaayo ba mubiri. Waliwo okusomoka “okuva mu mubiri okutuuka mu mwoyo.” Pawulo yasanga abakkiriza ab’omwoyo? Awatali kubuusabuusa yabasanga. Soma busomi essuula ey’omukaaga ey’Ebbaluwa eri Abaggalatiya! Eyo yali kkanisa ennyombo, obukyayi n’obuggya gye byali eby’entiisa. Naye omutume agamba mu lunyiriri olusooka nti: “Abooluganda omuntu bw’abanga alina ekibi ky’akoze, mmwe ab’omwoyo mumuluŋŋamyenga mu buwombeefu nga mwegendereza si kulwa nga nammwe mugwa mu kukemebwa.” Abaggalatiya 6:1. Awo tulaba nti obubonero bw’omuntu ow’omwoyo bwe buno: aliba muteefu; era aliba n’amaanyi, n’okwagala okuyamba n’okuzzaawo abo abagudde. Omuntu ow’omubiri tayinza kukola ekyo. Bwe wabaawo obulamu obw’omwoyo obwa ddala obuyinza okubeerwamu, ekibuuzo ekinene kiri nti: Ekkubo liggule, era nnyinza ntya okuyingira mu mbeera ey’omwoyo? Wano nate nnina okuddamu kuna okumpi. Ekisooka, tuteekwa okumanya nti waliwo obulamu obw’omwoyo ng’obwo abantu bwe bayinza okubeeramu ku nsi. Tewali kintu kisala bikolo bya bulamu bwa Kikristaayo nga obutakkiriza. Abantu tebakkiriza Katonda by’ayogedde ku by’ayagala okukolera abaana be. Abantu tebakkiriza nti Katonda bw’agamba nti, “Omwoyo ajjulenga mu bulamu bwammwe,” ekyo akigendereza eri buli Mukristaayo. Naye Pawulo yawandiikira Abaefeso ng’agamba nti: “Ate temutamiiranga, kubanga mujja kweyonoona, wabula Omwoyo ajjulenga mu bulamu bwammwe,” Abaefeso 5:18. Nga bwe kitakugwanira kutamiira wayini, bw’atyo bwe kitakugwanira kubeera mulamu nga tojjudde Mwoyo. Kale, Katonda bw’aba ng’ekyo akigendereza eri abakkiriza, ekintu ekisooka kye twetaaga kwe kuyiga n’okutwala Ekigambo kya Katonda ku mutima, okutuusa emitima gyaffe lwe gijjula obukakafu nti obulamu ng’obwo busoboka, era nti kye kitugwanira okubeeramu; nti tuyinza okuba abantu ab’omwoyo. Ekigambo kya Katonda kituyigiriza nti Katonda tasuubira muntu kubeera nga bw’asaanidde wadde edakiika emu, okuggyako nga Omwoyo Omutukuvu ali mu ye okumusobozesa okukikola. Tetwetaaga Mwoyo Mutukuvu lwokka nga tugenda kubuulira, oba nga tulina okugumira okukemebwa okw’enjawulo okwa Setaani, oba omugugu omunene okwetikka; Katonda agamba nti: “Omwana wange tayinza kubeera mu bulamu obutuufu okuggyako ng’akulemberwa Omwoyo wange buli dakiika.” Ako ke kabonero k’omwana wa Katonda: “kubanga abo bonna abakulemberwa Omwoyo wa Katonda be baana ba Katonda.” Abaruumi 8:14. Mu Abaruumi 5 tusoma nti: “kubanga Katonda atuwadde Mwoyo Mutukuvu ajjuza emitima gyaffe okwagala kwe.” Abaruumi 5:5. Ekyo kye kiteekwa okuba ekintu eky’abulijjo, ekya buli lunaku, omukkiriza ky’ayitamu; so si bulamu bwe mu biseera ebyateekebwawo byokka. Kitaawe w’omwana oba nnyina yali alowoozezza nti, “Leero lwokka njagala omwana wange anjagale?” Nedda, basuubira okwagala buli lunaku. Bw’atyo Katonda ayagala omwana we buli kaseera abeere n’omutima ogujjudde okwagala kw’Omwoyo. Mu maaso ga Katonda, kintu ekitali kya butonde n’akatono okusuubira omuntu okwagala nga bw’asaanidde nga tajjudde Mwoyo. Ai, ka tukkirize nti omuntu ayinza okuba omuntu ow’omwoyo. Katonda yeebazibwe, waliwo kaakano omukisa ogutulindiridde. “Omwoyo ajjulenga mu bulamu bwammwe.” “Mukulemberwenga Omwoyo.” Ogwo gwe mukisa. Bw’oba olina okugamba nti, “Ai, Katonda, sirina mukisa guno,” kyogere; naye era yogera nti, “Mukama, mmanyi nti kye kingwanidde, buvunaanyizibwa bwange obw’amaanyi okugufuna, kubanga awatali gwo siyinza kubeera mu mirembe egituukiridde naawe olunaku lwonna; awatali gwo siyinza kukugulumiza n’okukola omulimu gw’oyagala nkole.” Eryo lye ddaala lyaffe erisooka okuva mu mubiri okutuuka mu mwoyo: okukkiriza nti obulamu obw’omwoyo, okutambulira mu Mwoyo, tusobola okubutuukako. Tuyinza tutya okusaba Katonda atukulembere mu bulamu obw’omwoyo, nga tetulina bukakafu bulambulukufu era obunywevu nti waliwo obulamu ng’obwo obuyinza okufunibwa? Awo ne wajja eddaala ery’okubiri; omuntu ateekwa okulaba ensonyi n’omusango gw’okuba nti abadde mu bulamu ng’obwo. Abantu abamu bakkiriza nti waliwo obulamu obw’omwoyo obw’okubeeramu, era nti tebabubaddemu, ne beesaasira, ne beekwatirwa ekisa, ne balowooza nti, “Nga kya nnaku okuba nti ndi munafu nnyo okubufuna! Nga kya nnaku nti Katonda abuwa abalala, naye nze tabumpadde!” Beesaasira nnyo, mu kifo ky’okugamba nti, “Woowe! Obutaba beesigwa bwaffe, obutakkiriza bwaffe, n’obujeemu bwaffe bye bitulobedde okwewaayo ddala eri Katonda. Tuteekwa okukwatibwa ensonyi mu maaso ga Katonda olw’okuba nti tetubeera ng’abantu ab’omwoyo.” Omuntu tayinza kukyuka nga tannakakasibwa kibi kye. Okukakasibwa okwo bwe kujja, amaaso ge ne gazibuka, ayiga okutya ekibi kye, n’akiddukako n’agenda eri Kristo, n’akkiriza Kristo ng’Omununuzi ow’amaanyi. Naye omuntu yeetaaga okukakasibwa ekibi omulundi ogwokubiri; omukkiriza ateekwa okukakasibwa ekibi kye eky’enjawulo. Ebibi by’omuntu atannakyuka byawukana ku bibi by’omukkiriza. Ng’ekyokulabirako, omuntu atannakyuka emirundi mingi tafuna kukakasibwa kwonooneka kwa butonde bwe; okusingira ddala alowooza ku bibi eby’okungulu: “Ndayidde, mbadde mulimba, era ndi mu kkubo erigenda mu ggeyeena.” Olwo n’akakasibwa n’akyuka. Naye omukkiriza ali mu mbeera ya njawulo ddala. Ebibi bye bisingako nnyo okuba eby’omusango, kubanga yaweebwa ekitangaala n’okwagala n’Omwoyo wa Katonda. Ebibi bye bisingako nnyo obuziba. Afubye okubiwangula, era akuze okulaba nti obutonde bwe bwonoonefu ddala, nti endowooza ey’omubiri, omubiri oguli mu ye, gufuula embeera ye yonna eya nnaku ddala. Omukkiriza bw’akakasibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu, okusingira ddala obulamu bwe obw’obutakkiriza bwe bumusalira omusango, kubanga alaba nti omusango omunene ogukwatagana nabwo gwe gumulobedde okufuna ekirabo ekijjuvu eky’Omwoyo Omutukuvu owa Katonda. Akkakkanyizibwa mu nsonyi n’okutabulwa mu maaso, n’atandika okukaaba nti: “Amatu gange gaali gaakuwulirako dda, naye kaakano amaaso gange gakulabye.” Yobu 42:5. Katonda amusemberera. Yobu, omuntu omutuukirivu, Katonda gwe yeesiga, yalaba mu ye ekibi eky’amaanyi eky’obwannakyemalira n’obutuukirivu bwakyo, kye yali tannalabangako. Okutuusa okukakasibwa kuno okw’obubi bw’embeera yaffe ey’omubiri ng’abakkiriza lwe kujja ku buli omu ku ffe; okutuusa nga twagala okufuna okukakasibwa kuno okuva eri Katonda, okumala ekiseera mu maaso ga Katonda nga tukkakkanyizibwa era nga tukakasibwa, tetuyinza kufuuka bantu ba mwoyo. Awo ne wajja akabonero ak’okusatu, kwe kuba nti okuva mu mbeera ey’omubiri okutuuka mu mbeera ey’omwoyo ddaala limu lyokka. Eddaala limu; ai, obwo bubaka bwa mukisa bwe mbaleetedde—ddaala limu lyokka. Mmanyi nti abantu bangi bajja kugaana okukkiriza nti ddaala limu lyokka; balowooza nti kitono nnyo olw’enkyukakyuka ennene bwe etyo. Naye okukyuka tekwali ddaala limu lyokka? Bwe kiri bwe kityo omuntu bw’ava mu mubiri n’ayingira mu mwoyo. Obuuza oba nga bwe njogera ku muntu ow’omwoyo, sirowooza ku muntu eyakula mu by’omwoyo, omutukuvu owa ddala, n’ogamba nti: “Ekyo kijja mu lunaku lumu? Tewali kukula mu butukuvu?” Nkuddamu nti okukula mu by’omwoyo tekuyinza kujja mu lunaku lumu. Tetuyinza kukisuubira. Kyetaagisa okukula okutuusa obulungi bwonna obw’ekifaananyi kya Kristo lwe bukolebwa mu muntu. Naye era nkyagamba nti omuntu yeetaaga eddaala limu lyokka okuva mu bulamu obw’omubiri okuyingira mu bulamu obw’omwoyo. Kiba bwe kityo omuntu bw’akutula ddala n’omubiri; bw’awaayo omubiri eri okufa kwa Kristo okw’okukomererwa; bw’alaba nti buli kintu ekigukwatako kikolimire era nti tayinza kweggya mu gwo; n’alyoka yeeyuna amaanyi g’omusaalaba gwa Kristo agatta mu ye,—omuntu bw’akola ekyo n’agamba nti: “Obulamu buno obw’omwoyo obwanteekerwateekerwa kirabo kya bwereere okuva eri Katonda wange mu Kristo Yesu,” n’alyoka ategeera engeri eddaala limu gye liyinza okumuggya mu mbeera ey’omubiri ne limuyingiza mu ey’omwoyo. Mu bulamu obwo obw’omwoyo, wajja kubaayo bingi ebikyali eby’okuyiga. Omuntu bw’amala okwewaayo eri amaanyi ag’Omwoyo wa Katonda aga ddala, amalamu, agakola, era agafuga, aba atuuse mu kifo ekituufu mw’asobola okukulira. Tolowoozangako kukula ng’ova mu bulwadde n’oyingira mu bulamu obulungi; oyinza okukula ng’ova mu bunafu n’ogenda mu maanyi, ng’omwana omuwere bw’ayinza okukula n’afuuka omusajja ow’amaanyi; naye awali obulwadde, wateekwa okubaawo okuwonyezebwa bwe kuba nga ddala anaawona. Pawulo agamba nti obulamu obw’omubiri buteekwa okusalibwako. “N’abo aba Kristo Yesu baakomerera omubiri n’okwegomba kwagwo, n’omululu gwagwo.” Abaruumi 5:24. Omuntu bw’ategeera ekyo kye kitegeeza, n’akikkiriza mu kukkiriza kw’ebyo Kristo by’ayinza okukola, olwo eddaala limu liyinza okumuggya mu mubiri ne limutuusa mu mwoyo. Ekikolwa ekimu ekyangu eky’okukkiriza mu maanyi g’okufa kwa Kristo, ekikolwa ekimu eky’okwewaayo eri okussa ekimu mu kufa kwa Kristo nga Omwoyo Omutukuvu bw’ayinza okukufuula okwaffe, kujja kukufuula okwaffe, era kujja kukuleetera okununulibwa okuva mu buyinza bw’okufuba kwo. Kiki ekyaleetera okununulibwa omwonoonyi oli omwavu eyasalirwa omusango, eyali mu kizikiza ekingi era mu nnaku ennyingi mu mbeera ye ey’obutakyuka? Yawulira nti tayinza kwekolera kirungi kyonna. Yakola ki? Yalaba mu maaso ge Omulokozi ow’obuyinza bwonna, ne yeesuula mu mikono gye; ne yeeteeka mu kwagala okwo okw’obuyinza bwonna, n’akaaba nti, “Mukama, onsaasire.” Obwo bwe bwali obulokozi. Kristo teyamukkiriza lwa ekyo kye yakola. Mmwe abakkiriza, bwe wabaawo ku ffe amanyi nti embeera ey’omubiri y’esinga mu ye, n’ateekwa okugamba nti: “Kino kinkwatako; ndi muntu wa ddiini, omuntu omunyiikivu, mukwano gw’emirimu gy’obuminsani; nkolera Kristo mu kkanisa yange, naye, woowe! obusungu n’ekibi n’okwagala ensi bikyafuga emmeeme yange,” wulira ekigambo kya Katonda. Bwe wabaawo anajja n’agamba nti: “Nfubye, nsabye, nkaabye, naye tekinnyambye,” olwo oteekwa okukola ekintu ekirala kimu. Oteekwa okulaba nti Kristo omulamu ye Katonda gw’akuteekeddewo olw’obulamu bwo obutukuvu era obw’omwoyo. Oteekwa okukkiriza nti Kristo oyo eyakukkiriza edda, ng’okyuka, mu kwagala kwe okw’ekitalo, kaakano akulindiridde okukugamba nti oyinza okufuuka omuntu ow’omwoyo, eyeewaddeyo ddala eri Katonda. Bw’okkiriza ekyo, okutya kwo kujja kuggwaawo era ojja kugamba nti: “Kisoboka; Kristo bw’anakkiriza n’akivunaanyizibwa, kijja kukolebwa.” Kaakano akabonero kange akasembayo. Omuntu ateekwa okulinnya eddaala eryo, eddaala ery’amaanyi naye ery’omukisa. Abamu ku mmwe kyabatwalira emyaka etaano oba kkumi okulinnya eddaala ery’okukyuka. Mwakaaba ne musaba okumala emyaka, ne mutafuna mirembe okutuusa lwe mwalinnya eddaala eryo. Bwe kityo, ne mu bulamu obw’omwoyo, oyinza okugenda eri omusomesa omu ne oli, n’ogamba nti, “Mbuulira ku bulamu obw’omwoyo, ku kubatizibwa kw’Omwoyo, ne ku butukuvu,” naye n’osigala nga bwe wali. Bangi ku ffe twandyagadde ekibi kiggyibweko. Ani ayagala okuba n’obusungu obw’amangu? Ani ayagala okuba n’emmeeme ey’amalala? Ani ayagala okuba n’omutima ogw’ensi? Tewali n’omu. Tugenda eri Kristo akiggyewo, n’atakikola, ne tubuuza nti, “Lwaki takikola? Nsabye n’obunyiikivu bungi.” Kiri bwe kityo kubanga wayagala aggyewo ebibala ebibi nga ekikolo eky’obutwa kisigala mu ggwe. Tewamusaba nti omubiri gukomererwe ku musaalaba gwe, era nti okuva olwo weewaayo ddala eri amaanyi g’Omwoyo we. Okununulibwa kuliwo, naye si mu ngeri gye tukunoonyamu. Teebereza omusiizi w’ebifaananyi alina olugoye lw’okusiigako, ng’ayagala okukolerako ekifaananyi ekirungi. Teebereza olugoye olwo si lulwe, era buli muntu alina eddembe okulutwala n’alukozesa ku kigendererwa ekirala kyonna; olowooza omusiizi oyo yandiruteekeddeko omulimu mungi? Nedda. Naye abantu baagala Yesu Kristo yeeteeke mu buzibu ku lwabwe ng’abaggyako obusungu buno oba ekibi ekirala kiri, so nga mu mitima gyabwe tebeewaddeyo ddala eri okulagira kwe n’okukuuma kwe. Tekiyinza kubaawo. Naye bw’onoojja n’owaayo obulamu bwo bwonna mu mikono gye, Kristo Yesu wa maanyi okulokola; Kristo Yesu alindirira okuba ow’ekisa; Kristo Yesu alindirira okukujjuza Omwoyo we. Tolinnye ddaala eryo? Katonda atuwe ekyo, tukulemberwe Omwoyo we okwewaayo gy’ali nga bwe tutakolangako. Tojja mu kwatula okw’obuwombeefu? Woowe! Obulamu obw’omubiri bwasukkiridde okufuga, bukufuze ddala, era olina okuwulira okukaawa nti wadde Katonda akuwadde emikisa gyonna egyo, takufudde ky’oyagala okuba—omuntu ow’omwoyo? Omwoyo Omutukuvu yekka, ng’abeera mu ggwe, y’ayinza okufuula omuntu ow’omwoyo. Kale jjangu weesuule ku bigere bya Katonda, n’ekirowoozo kino kimu, “Mukama, neewaayo gy’oli ng’ekibya ekyereere okujjuzibwa Omwoyo wo.” Buli omu ku mmwe buli lunaku alaba ku mmeeza ya caayi ekikopo ekyereere nga kiteekeddwawo, nga kirindirira okujjuzibwamu caayi ekiseera ekituufu bwe kituuka. Bwe kiri ne ku buli kibya, na buli sowaani: biyonjebwa ne bifuukulwa, nga byetegefu okujjuzibwa. Nga bifuukuddwa era nga biyonjeddwa. Ai, jjangu! Era ng’ekibya bwe kiwulwa okutoola ekyo kye kigenda okubaamu, gamba Kristo nti okuva mu ssaawa eno oyagala okuba ekibya ekyawuliddwa okujjuzibwa Omwoyo we, ng’oweereddwayo okuba omuntu ow’omwoyo. Vunnama mu bwereere obusingayo obuziba obw’emmeeme yo, ogambe nti, “Ai, Katonda, sirina kintu!” era olwo, mazima ddala, bwe weeteeka mu maaso ge, olina eddembe okugamba nti, “Katonda wange ajja kutuukiriza ekisuubizo kye! Mmusaba anzijuze Omwoyo Omutukuvu, anfuule Omukristaayo ow’omwoyo mu kifo ky’ow’omubiri.” Bw’oneeteeka ku bigere bye n’olindirira awo; bw’onoobeera mu kwewaayo okwo okw’obuwombeefu n’okwesiga okwo okw’omwana omuto, nga Katonda bw’ali omulamu, omukisa gujja kujja. Ai, tetuteekwa kuvunnama mu nsonyi mu maaso ga Katonda, bwe tulowooza ku Kkanisa ye yonna ne tulaba nga ebyomubiri bingi bwe bifuga? Tetuteekwa kuvunnama mu nsonyi mu maaso ga Katonda, bwe tulowooza ku bya mubiri ebingi ennyo mu mitima gyaffe ne mu bulamu bwaffe? Kale ka tuvunname n’okukkiriza okungi mu kusaasira kwa Katonda. Okununulibwa kuli kumpi, okununulibwa kujja, okununulibwa kulindiridde, okununulibwa kukakafu. Ka twesige; Katonda ajja kukutuwa.

fields.title: Obulamu bw’Obwannakyemalira
fields.body_html:
“Awo Yesu n’agamba abayigirizwa be nti, “Omuntu bw’ayagala okungoberera asaana yeefiirize yekka, yeetikke omusaalaba gwe alyoke angoberere.” Matayo 16:24.

Mu lunyiriri olw’ekkumi n’essatu tusoma nti Yesu bwe yali mu Kayisaliya ekya Firipo yabuuza abayigirizwa be nti, “Abantu Omwana w’Omuntu bagamba nti ye ani?” Bwe baamala okuddamu, n’ababuuza nti, “Mmwe mundowooza kuba ani?” Era mu lunyiriri olw’ekkumi n’omukaaga, Peetero n’addamu nti, “Ggwe Kristo, Omwana wa Katonda omulamu.” Yesu n’amuddamu mu nnyiriri eziddirira nti: “Olina omukisa Simooni, omwana wa Yona, kubanga ekyo Kitange ali mu ggulu y’akikubikkulidde, so tokiggye mu bantu. Era nkutegeeza nti, Ggwe Peetero, olwazi, era ku lwazi okwo kwe ndizimba Ekkanisa yange, n’amaanyi gonna aga Setaani tegaligiwangula.” Awo mu lunyiriri olw’amakumi abiri mu olumu, tusoma engeri Yesu gye yatandika okubuulira abayigirizwa be ku kufa kwe okwali kusembera; ne mu lunyiriri olw’amakumi abiri mu ebbiri, engeri Peetero gye yatandika okumunenya ng’agamba nti, “Katonda akulage ekisa Mukama waffe. Bino tebirikutuukako.” Naye n’akyuka n’agamba Peetero mu lunyiriri oluddako nti, “Dda ennyuma wange Setaani. Oli kyesittaza gye ndi, kubanga tolowoozeza bintu bya Katonda wabula olowooza bintu bya bantu.”

Awo Yesu n’agamba abayigirizwa be nti, “Omuntu bw’ayagala okungoberera asaana yeefiirize yekka, yeetikke omusaalaba gwe alyoke angoberere.” Emirundi mingi tuwulira ku bulamu obw’okwetabika, era ekibuuzo ne kijja nti, kiki ekiri ku kikolo kyabwo?

Nsonga ki lwaki Abakristaayo bangi bonoona obulamu bwabwe mu buddu obw’entiisa obw’ensi, mu kifo ky’okubeera mu kweyoleka kwa Katonda, ne mu nkizo ye, ne mu kitiibwa kye? Era ekibuuzo ekirala oboolyawo kijja gye tuli: Nsonga ki lwaki bwe tulaba ekintu nga kibi ne tukirwanyisa, ne tutasobola kukiwangula? Nsonga ki lwaki tusabye emirundi kikumi ne twelayirira, naye wuuno tukyali mu bulamu obutabuddwatabuddwa, obwawuddwamu, obw’omutima ogw’ekitundu? Ebibuuzo ebyo byombi birina okuddamu kumu: obwannakyemalira kye kikolo ky’obuzibu bwonna.

Noolwekyo, omuntu yenna bw’ambuuza nti, “Nnyinza ntya okuva mu bulamu buno obw’okwetabika?” okuddamu tekwandibadde nti, “Oteekwa okukola kino, oba kiri, oba ekirala,” naye okuddamu kwandibadde nti, “Obulamu obuggya obuva waggulu, obulamu bwa Kristo, buteekwa okudda mu kifo ky’obulamu bw’obwannakyemalira; olwo tusobole okuba abawanguzi.

Bulijjo tuva ku by’ebweru ne tugenda ku by’omunda; ka tukole bwe tutyo ne wano; mu bigambo bino eby’ekyawandiikibwa ka tulowooze ku kigambo kimu, “yekka”—kwe kugamba obwannakyemalira. Yesu yagamba Peetero nti: “Omuntu bw’ayagala okungoberera asaana yeefiirize yekka, yeetikke omusaalaba gwe alyoke angoberere.” Matayo 16:24. Ako ke kabonero k’omuyigirizwa; ekyo kye kyama ky’obulamu bw’Ekikristaayo—weefiirize obwannakyemalira, byonna bijja kutereera. Mujjukire nti Peetero yali mukkiriza, era omukkiriza eyali ayigiriziddwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Yali awadde okuddamu okwasanyusa ennyo Kristo: “Ggwe Kristo, Omwana wa Katonda omulamu.” Temulowooza nti ekyo kyali kintu kya kitalo. Ffe tukiyigira mu katekisimu waffe; Peetero teyakiyiga bw’atyo; era Kristo yalaba nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu owa Kitaffe ye yali amuyigiriza, n’agamba nti: “Olina omukisa Simooni, omwana wa Yona”

Naye mulabe omuntu ow’omubiri bw’akyali n’amaanyi mu Peetero.

Kristo ayogera ku musaalaba gwe; Peetero yali asobola okutegeera ku kitiibwa, “Ggwe Kristo, Omwana wa Katonda omulamu.”

Matayo 16:16. Naye waliwo ekintu ku musaalaba ne ku kufa kye yali tasobola kutegeera, n’aguma mu kwesiga kwe n’agamba nti, “Katonda akulage ekisa Mukama waffe. Bino tebirikutuukako.” Matayo 16:22. Era Kristo yalina okumunenya: “Dda ennyuma wange Setaani. Oli kyesittaza gye ndi, kubanga tolowoozeza bintu bya Katonda wabula olowooza bintu bya bantu.” Matayo 16:23.

Kristo ne yeeyongera n’agamba nti, “Omuntu bw’ayagala okungoberera asaana yeefiirize yekka, yeetikke omusaalaba gwe alyoke angoberere.” Matayo 16:24. Ka tulwe ku kigambo kino kimu, “yekka” Bwe tuyiga okumanya obwannakyemalira kye ki, olwo lwokka lwe tumanya ddala ekiri ku kikolo ky’okulemererwa kwaffe kwonna, ne twetegekera okugenda eri Kristo okununulibwa.

Ka tulowooze, ekisooka, ku butonde bw’obulamu buno obw’obwannakyemalira, oluvannyuma tulage ebimu ku bikolwa byabwo, oluvannyuma tubuuze ekibuuzo nti: “Tuyinza tutya okubununulibwamu?” Obwannakyemalira (nze) ge maanyi Katonda ge yatonderamu era ge yawa buli kitonde ekirina amagezi. Obwannakyemalira gwe mutima gwennyini ogw’ekitonde. Era lwaki Katonda yawa bamalayika oba omuntu obwannakyemalira?

Ekigendererwa ky’obwannakyemalira buno kyali kino: tubuleete ng’ekibya ekyereere eri Katonda; alyoke abuteekemu obulamu bwe.

Katonda yampa amaanyi ag’okwesalirawo, ndyoke ndeete obwannakyemalira buno buli lunaku nga ŋŋamba nti: “Ai, Katonda, kolera mu bwo; mbukuwa.” Katonda yayagala ekibya mw’ayinza okufuka obujjuvu bwe obw’obwakatonda obw’obulungi, n’amagezi, n’amaanyi. Yatonda ensi, enjuba, omwezi, emmunyeenye, emiti, ebimuli n’omuddo, byonna ebiraga obugagga bw’amagezi ge, obulungi bwe n’ekisa kye. Naye bikola ekyo nga tebimanyi kye bikola.

Awo Katonda n’atonda bamalayika nga balina obwannakyemalira n’okwagala, alabe oba nga bajja kujja beewe gy’ali ku bwabwe ng’ebibya by’ajjuza. Naye woowe! Bonna tebaakola bwe batyo. Waaliwo omu eyali omukulu w’ekibiina ekinene, n’atandika okwetunuulira, n’okulowooza ku maanyi ag’ekitalo Katonda ge yali amuwadde, n’okwesanyusaamu. N’atandika okulowooza nti: “Ekitonde ng’omuntu nze kiteekwa okusigala nga kyesigamye ku Katonda bulijjo?” Ne yeegulumiza, amalala ne geeyoleka mu kweyawula ku Katonda, era mu kaseera ako kennyini, mu kifo ky’okuba malayika mu Ggulu, n’afuuka sitaani mu ggeyeena. Obwannakyemalira obukyukidde Katonda kye kitiibwa ky’okuleka Omutonzi okweyoleka mu ffe. Obwannakyemalira obukyuse ne buva ku Katonda kye kizikiza kyennyini n’omuliro ogwa ggeyeena.

Ffenna tumanyi olugero olw’entiisa olw’ebyaddirira; Katonda yatonda omuntu, Setaani n’ajja mu kifaananyi ky’omusota n’akema Kaawa n’ekirowoozo eky’okufaanana Katonda, okuba n’obwannakyemalira obwetongodde, okumanya ekirungi n’ekibi. Era bwe yali ayogera naye, yamufuuwamu, mu bigambo ebyo, obutwa bwennyini n’amalala gennyini aga ggeyeena. Omwoyo gwe omubi, obutwa bwennyini obwa ggeyeena, ne buyingira mu bantu, era obwannakyemalira buno obukolimire bwe twasikira okuva ku bazadde baffe abaasooka. Bwe bwannakyemalira obwo obwazikiriza ensi eno ne bugireetako okuzikirira, era byonna ebibaddewo eby’ekibi, n’ekizikiza, n’obuyinike, n’obunaku; ne byonna ebiribaawo mu mirembe egitabalika egy’emirembe n’emirembe mu ggeyeena, tebiriba birala wabula obufuzi bw’obwannakyemalira, ekikolimo ky’obwannakyemalira, ekyawula omuntu ne kimukyusa okuva ku Katonda we. Era bwe tuba ab’okutegeera mu bujjuvu Kristo ky’agenda okutukolera, era ab’okugabana ku bulokozi obujjuvu, tuteekwa okuyiga okumanya obwannakyemalira buno obukolimire, okubukyawa, n’okubuleka ddala.

Kale, bikolwa ki eby’obwannakyemalira? Nnyinza okwogera ku bingi, naye ka tutwale ebigambo ebisinga obwangu bye tukozesa buli kiseera: okwekulembeza okwagala kwange, okwekkiririzaamu, n’okwegulumiza. Okwekulembeza okwagala kwange, okwesanyusa, kye kibi ekinene eky’omuntu, era kye kiri ku kikolo ky’okwetabika kwonna n’ensi, okwo okuzikirizza bangi. Abantu tebasobola kutegeera lwaki tebasaanidde kwesanyusa n’okukola bye baagala. Abakristaayo bangi tebategeeranga nti Omukristaayo muntu atasaanidde kunoonya by’ayagala ye wabula bulijjo okunoonya Katonda by’ayagala, ng’omuntu omwoyo gwennyini ogwa Kristo mwe gubeera. “Mukama, nzize okukola by’oyagala, Ayi Katonda wange!” Tusanga Abakristaayo nga beesanyusa mu ngeri lukumi, naye nga bagezaako okuba abasanyufu, abalungi era ab’omugaso, so nga tebamanyi nti ku kikolo kya byonna waliwo okwekulembeza okwagala kwabwe okubanyagako omukisa.

Abakristaayo, mutunuulire obulamu bwammwe mu kitangaala ky’ebigambo bya Yesu. Musangamu okwekulembeza okwagala kwammwe, okwesanyusa?

Jjukira kino: buli lw’oyesanyusa, oba weegaana Yesu. Kimu ku bibiri. Oteekwa okumusanyusa Ye yekka, ne weefiiriza obwannakyemalira, oba oteekwa okwesanyusa ggwe, ne weegaana Ye. Awo ne kiddako okwekkiririzaamu, okwesiga, okufuba okw’amaanyi go, n’okwesigama ku ggwe kennyini. Kiki ekyaleetera Peetero okwegaana Yesu? Kristo yali amulabudde; lwaki teyakkiriza kulabula? Okwekkiririzaamu. Yali mukakafu nnyo: “Mukama wange, nkwagala. Emyaka esatu nga nkugoberera. Mukama wange, ŋŋaana nti ekyo kiyinza okubaawo. Neeteeseteese okusibirwa awamu naawe mu kkomera, era n’okufiira awamu naawe.” Kwali kwekkiririzaamu kwokka.

Abantu emirundi mingi bambuuzizza nti, “Nsonga ki lwaki ndemererwa? Njagala nnyo, era nsaba n’obunyiikivu, okubeera mu Katonda by’ayagala.” Era emirundi mingi nziramu nti, “Kubanga weesiga ggwe kennyini.” Ne banziramu nti: “Nedda, sikola ekyo; mmanyi nti siri mulungi, era mmanyi nti Katonda mwetegefu okunkuuma, era neesiga Yesu.” Naye nziramu nti, “Nedda, owooluganda; nedda; singa weesiga Katonda ne Yesu, towandigudde, naye weesiga ggwe kennyini.” Ka tukkirize nti ensonga ya buli kulemererwa mu bulamu bw’Ekikristaayo si ndala wabula eno. Nneesiga obwannakyemalira buno obukolimire, mu kifo ky’okwesiga Yesu. Nneesiga amaanyi gange, mu kifo ky’amaanyi ga Katonda ag’obuyinza bwonna. Era eyo y’ensonga lwaki Kristo agamba nti, “Obwannakyemalira buno buteekwa okwefiirizibwa”.

Waliwo okwegulumiza, engeri endala ey’ebikolwa by’obwannakyemalira. Ai, nga mu nsi ey’Ekikristaayo mulimu amalala n’obuggya bingi; nga tuwulira nnyo ebyo abantu bye boogera ku ffe oba bye batulowoozaako; nga twegomba nnyo okutenderezebwa abantu n’okusanyusa abantu, mu kifo ky’okubeeranga bulijjo mu maaso ga Katonda, n’ekirowoozo kimu: “Mmusanyusa?” Kristo yagamba nti, “Kale muyinza mutya okukkiriza nga munoonya kusiimibwa bantu bannammwe, so nga temunoonya kusiimibwa Katonda oyo Omu yekka?” Yokaana 5:44. Okunoonya ekitiibwa okuva buli omu ku munne kufuula obulamu obw’okukkiriza obutasoboka n’akatono. Obwannakyemalira buno bwava mu ggeyeena, bwatwawula ku Katonda, mulimba akolimiddwa atuwabya okuva ku Yesu. Kaakano tutuuse ku nsonga ey’okusatu. Tukole ki okubweggyako?

Yesu atuddamu mu bigambo by’ekyawandiikibwa kyaffe: “Omuntu bw’ayagala okungoberera asaana yeefiirize yekka, yeetikke omusaalaba gwe alyoke angoberere.” Matayo 16:24. Kitegeere bulungi. Nteekwa okwefiiriza nze kennyini ne ntwala Yesu yennyini ng’obulamu bwange; nteekwa okulondawo. Waliwo obulamu bubiri, obulamu bw’obwannakyemalira, n’obulamu bwa Kristo; nteekwa okulondamu obumu ku bubiri. “Ngoberera,” bw’ayogera Mukama waffe, “nfuula etteeka ly’obulamu bwo, ekiragiro ky’empisa zo; mpa omutima gwo gwonna; ngoberera, nange nja kufaayo ku byonna.” Ai, mikwano gyange, kuwanyisiganya kwa maanyi okuteekeddwa mu maaso gaffe; okujja, nga tulabye akabi k’obwannakyemalira buno, n’amalala gaabwo n’obubi bwabwo, okwesuula mu maaso g’Omwana wa Katonda, ne tugamba nti, “Neefiiriza obulamu bwange, ntwala obulamu bwo okuba obwange.”

Ensonga lwaki Abakristaayo basaba ne basaba obulamu bwa Kristo bubayingiremu, ne kitavaamu kantu, kwe kuba nti obulamu bw’obwannakyemalira tebwefiirizibwa. Obuuza nti, “Nnyinza ntya okweggyako obulamu buno obw’obwannakyemalira?” Omanyi olugero: omuntu yasigala mu nnyumba okutuusa ow’amaanyi omu lwe yayingira n’amugobamu. Awo ennyumba n’eyonjebwa n’erongoosebwa, naye nga nkalu, n’adda n’emyoyo emirala musanvu egimusinga obubi. Matayo 12:43-45. Kristo yekka bw’ayingira y’ayinza okugobamu obwannakyemalira, n’okubukuumira ebweru. Obwannakyemalira buno bujja kubeera naffe okutuusa ku nkomerero ddala. Mujjukire omutume Pawulo; yali alabye okwolesebwa okw’omu Ggulu, era aleme kwegulumiza, n’aweebwa eriggwa mu mubiri okumukkakkanya. Mu ye mwalimu okwegomba okwegulumiza, ekyali eky’obutonde, era kyandiwangudde, naye Kristo n’amununula okuva mu kyo olw’okumulabirira kwe okw’obwesigwa eri omuweereza we gwe yali ayagala.

Yesu Kristo ayinza, olw’ekisa kye eky’obwakatonda, okuziyiza amaanyi g’obwannakyemalira obutaddamu kweyoleka wadde okufuna obuyinza; Yesu Kristo mwetegefu okufuuka obulamu bw’emmeeme; Yesu Kristo mwetegefu okutuyigiriza okumugoberera bwe tutyo, n’okuba n’omutima n’obulamu ebimussaako Ye yekka, alyoke abeere bulijjo era emirembe gyonna ekitangaala ky’emmeeme zaffe.

Awo tutuuka ku ekyo omutume Pawulo ky’agamba nti: “ndi mulamu, si ku bwange, wabula ku bwa Kristo abeera mu nze” Amazima ago abiri gagenda wamu. Okusooka, “si ku bwange,” oluvannyuma, “wabula ku bwa Kristo abeera mu nze.” Abaggalatiya 2:20. Mutunuulire Peetero nate.

Kristo yamugamba nti, “asaana yeefiirize yekka, yeetikke omusaalaba gwe alyoke angoberere.” Matayo 16:24.

Yesu yamukulembera okutuuka e Gesusemane, era eyo Peetero n’alemererwa, kubanga yeebaka mu kiseera we yali asaanidde okutunula, ng’alindirira era ng’asaba; n’amukulembera okwolekera Gologoosa, mu kifo Peetero we yamwegaanira. Ogwo gwali bukulembeze bwa Kristo? Katonda yeebazibwe, bwe gwali. Omwoyo Omutukuvu yali tannajja mu maanyi ge; Peetero yali akyali muntu wa mubiri; omwoyo nga gwagala, naye nga tegusobola kuwangula; omubiri nga munafu. Kristo yakola ki? Yakulembera Peetero okutuusa lwe yamenyekamenyeka mu kwetoowaza okujjuvu, n’akkakkanyizibwa mu buziba bw’ennaku. Yesu n’amukulembera, n’ayita ku ntaana, n’ayita mu Kuzuukira, okutuuka ku Pentekooti, Omwoyo Omutukuvu n’ajja, era mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu Kristo n’ajja n’obulamu bwe obw’obwakatonda, olwo ne kiba nti, “Kristo abeera mu nze.”

Waliwo ekkubo limu lyokka ery’okununulibwa okuva mu bulamu buno obw’obwannakyemalira. Tuteekwa okugoberera Kristo, okumussaako emitima gyaffe, okuwuliriza okuyigiriza kwe, n’okwewaayo buli lunaku abeere byonna gye tuli, era olw’amaanyi ga Kristo okwefiiriza obwannakyemalira kunaabanga kwa mukisa, ekitakoma era ekya ddala. Sisuubira n’akamu Omukristaayo okutuuka ku ssaawa emu ku ddaala w’ayinza okugamba nti, “Sikyalina bwannakyemalira bwa kwefiiriza;” era sisuubira kaseera na kamu w’ayinza okugamba nti, “Seetaaga kwefiiriza bwannakyemalira.” Nedda, okussa kuno ekimu n’omusaalaba gwa Kristo kunaabanga kwefiiriza bwannakyemalira obutakoma buli ssaawa na buli kaseera olw’ekisa kya Katonda. Tewali kifo we wabeera okununulibwa okujjuvu okuva mu buyinza bw’obwannakyemalira buno obw’ekibi.

Tuteekwa okukomererwa wamu ne Kristo Yesu. Tuteekwa okubeera wamu naye ng’abo abaabatizibwa mu kufa kwe. Kirowoozeeko ekyo! Kristo teyalina bwannakyemalira bwa kibi, naye yalina obwannakyemalira (nze), era obwo yabuwaayo ddala eri okufa. Mu Gesusemane yagamba nti, “si nga Nze bwe njagala” Lukka 22:42. Obwannakyemalira obwo obutaayonoona yabuwaayo eri okufa alyoke abuddize nate okuva mu ntaana okuva eri Katonda, nga buzuukiziddwa era nga bugulumiziddwa. Tuyinza okusuubira okugenda mu Ggulu mu kkubo eddala okuggyako eryo lye yayitamu? Mwekuume! Mujjukire nti Kristo yakka mu kufa ne mu ntaana, era mu kufa kw’obwannakyemalira, nga tugoberera Yesu okutuuka ku nkomerero, mwe muliva okununulibwa n’obulamu.

Era kaakano, essomo lino erya Mukama waffe tunaalikozesa tutya? Essomo erisooka liriba nti tusaanidde okumala ekiseera ne twetoowaza mu maaso ga Katonda, nga tulowooza ku obwannakyemalira buno kye buli mu ffe; tubuvunaane buli kibi, buli kubulwa, buli kulemererwa, ne byonna ebibadde bivvoola Katonda, olwo tugambe nti, “Mukama, bwe ntyo bwe ndi;” era oluvannyuma tuleke Yesu Kristo ow’omukisa okufuga ddala obulamu bwaffe, nga tukkiriza nti obulamu bwe buyinza okuba obwaffe.

Temulowooza nti kintu kyangu okweggyako obwannakyemalira. Mu lukuŋŋaana olw’okwewaayo, kyangu okwelayirira, okusaba okusaba okumu, n’okukola ekikolwa eky’okwewaayo, naye ng’okufa kwa Kristo ku Gologoosa bwe kwali okw’amaanyi, okuwaayo kwe obulamu bwe obutaayonoona eri Katonda; bwe kityo bwe kiteekwa okuba eky’amaanyi wakati waffe ne Katonda waffe—okuwaayo obwannakyemalira eri okufa.

Amaanyi g’okufa kwa Kristo gateekwa okujja ne gakolera mu ffe buli lunaku. Ai, lowooza enjawukana eriwo wakati wa Peetero oyo eyeekulembezanga okwagala kwe, ne Yesu ng’awaayo okwagala kwe eri Katonda! Enjawukana nga nnene wakati w’okwegulumiza kwa Peetero, n’obuwombeefu obw’obuziba obw’Omwana gw’Endiga owa Katonda, omuteefu era omuwombeefu mu mutima mu maaso ga Katonda n’abantu! Enjawukana nga nnene wakati w’okwekkiririzaamu kwa Peetero, n’okwesigama okw’obuziba okwa Yesu ku Kitaffe, bwe yagamba nti: “Nze siyinza kukola kintu kyonna ku bwange.”

Tuyitibwa okubeera mu bulamu bwa Kristo, era Kristo ajja okubeera n’obulamu bwe mu ffe, naye waliwo ekintu kimu ekiteekwa okusooka okubaawo; tuteekwa okuyiga okukyawa obwannakyemalira buno n’okubwefiiriza. Nga Peetero bwe yeegaana Kristo, naffe tuteekwa okugamba nti twefiiriza obwannakyemalira, Kristo Yesu alyoke abeere byonna mu byonna. Ka twetoowaze nga tulowooza ku obwannakyemalira buno bye bututuusizzaako n’engeri gye buvvoodde Yesu; era ka tusabe n’obunyiikivu bungi: “Mukama, mu kitangaala kyo, yolesa obwannakyemalira buno; tukwegayirira obututegeeze. Zibula amaaso gaffe, tulabe bye bukoze, era nti kye kiziyiza kyokka ekibadde kituziyiza.”

Ka tusabe bwe tutyo n’obunyiikivu, era oluvannyuma tulindirire Katonda okutuusa lwe tuva mu mikolo gyaffe gyonna egy’eddiini, ne mu bye tuyiseemu byonna eby’eddiini, ne mu mikisa gyaffe gyonna, okutuusa lwe tusemberera Katonda, n’okusaba kuno kumu: “Mukama Katonda, obwannakyemalira bwafuula malayika omukulu okuba sitaani, era obwannakyemalira bwazikiriza bazadde bange abaasooka ne bubaggya mu Lusuku Adeni ne bubatwala mu kizikiza ne mu nnaku, era obwannakyemalira bubadde kuzikirira kw’obulamu bwange n’ensonga ya buli kulemererwa; ai, bwolese gye ndi.” Era olwo ne kujja okuwanyisiganya okw’omukisa, omuntu n’afuulibwa omwetegefu era asobola okugamba nti: “Omulala ajja kumbeerera mu bulamu, omulala ajja kubeera nange, omulala ajja kunkolera byonna,” Tewali kirala kinaabimala. Weefiirize obwannakyemalira; weetikke omusaalaba, ofiire wamu ne Yesu; mugoberere Ye yekka.

Atuwe ekisa okutegeera, okutoola, n’okubeera mu bulamu bwa Kristo.
fields.body_text: “Awo Yesu n’agamba abayigirizwa be nti, “Omuntu bw’ayagala okungoberera asaana yeefiirize yekka, yeetikke omusaalaba gwe alyoke angoberere.” Matayo 16:24. Mu lunyiriri olw’ekkumi n’essatu tusoma nti Yesu bwe yali mu Kayisaliya ekya Firipo yabuuza abayigirizwa be nti, “Abantu Omwana w’Omuntu bagamba nti ye ani?” Bwe baamala okuddamu, n’ababuuza nti, “Mmwe mundowooza kuba ani?” Era mu lunyiriri olw’ekkumi n’omukaaga, Peetero n’addamu nti, “Ggwe Kristo, Omwana wa Katonda omulamu.” Yesu n’amuddamu mu nnyiriri eziddirira nti: “Olina omukisa Simooni, omwana wa Yona, kubanga ekyo Kitange ali mu ggulu y’akikubikkulidde, so tokiggye mu bantu. Era nkutegeeza nti, Ggwe Peetero, olwazi, era ku lwazi okwo kwe ndizimba Ekkanisa yange, n’amaanyi gonna aga Setaani tegaligiwangula.” Awo mu lunyiriri olw’amakumi abiri mu olumu, tusoma engeri Yesu gye yatandika okubuulira abayigirizwa be ku kufa kwe okwali kusembera; ne mu lunyiriri olw’amakumi abiri mu ebbiri, engeri Peetero gye yatandika okumunenya ng’agamba nti, “Katonda akulage ekisa Mukama waffe. Bino tebirikutuukako.” Naye n’akyuka n’agamba Peetero mu lunyiriri oluddako nti, “Dda ennyuma wange Setaani. Oli kyesittaza gye ndi, kubanga tolowoozeza bintu bya Katonda wabula olowooza bintu bya bantu.” Awo Yesu n’agamba abayigirizwa be nti, “Omuntu bw’ayagala okungoberera asaana yeefiirize yekka, yeetikke omusaalaba gwe alyoke angoberere.” Emirundi mingi tuwulira ku bulamu obw’okwetabika, era ekibuuzo ne kijja nti, kiki ekiri ku kikolo kyabwo? Nsonga ki lwaki Abakristaayo bangi bonoona obulamu bwabwe mu buddu obw’entiisa obw’ensi, mu kifo ky’okubeera mu kweyoleka kwa Katonda, ne mu nkizo ye, ne mu kitiibwa kye? Era ekibuuzo ekirala oboolyawo kijja gye tuli: Nsonga ki lwaki bwe tulaba ekintu nga kibi ne tukirwanyisa, ne tutasobola kukiwangula? Nsonga ki lwaki tusabye emirundi kikumi ne twelayirira, naye wuuno tukyali mu bulamu obutabuddwatabuddwa, obwawuddwamu, obw’omutima ogw’ekitundu? Ebibuuzo ebyo byombi birina okuddamu kumu: obwannakyemalira kye kikolo ky’obuzibu bwonna. Noolwekyo, omuntu yenna bw’ambuuza nti, “Nnyinza ntya okuva mu bulamu buno obw’okwetabika?” okuddamu tekwandibadde nti, “Oteekwa okukola kino, oba kiri, oba ekirala,” naye okuddamu kwandibadde nti, “Obulamu obuggya obuva waggulu, obulamu bwa Kristo, buteekwa okudda mu kifo ky’obulamu bw’obwannakyemalira; olwo tusobole okuba abawanguzi. Bulijjo tuva ku by’ebweru ne tugenda ku by’omunda; ka tukole bwe tutyo ne wano; mu bigambo bino eby’ekyawandiikibwa ka tulowooze ku kigambo kimu, “yekka”—kwe kugamba obwannakyemalira. Yesu yagamba Peetero nti: “Omuntu bw’ayagala okungoberera asaana yeefiirize yekka, yeetikke omusaalaba gwe alyoke angoberere.” Matayo 16:24. Ako ke kabonero k’omuyigirizwa; ekyo kye kyama ky’obulamu bw’Ekikristaayo—weefiirize obwannakyemalira, byonna bijja kutereera. Mujjukire nti Peetero yali mukkiriza, era omukkiriza eyali ayigiriziddwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Yali awadde okuddamu okwasanyusa ennyo Kristo: “Ggwe Kristo, Omwana wa Katonda omulamu.” Temulowooza nti ekyo kyali kintu kya kitalo. Ffe tukiyigira mu katekisimu waffe; Peetero teyakiyiga bw’atyo; era Kristo yalaba nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu owa Kitaffe ye yali amuyigiriza, n’agamba nti: “Olina omukisa Simooni, omwana wa Yona” Naye mulabe omuntu ow’omubiri bw’akyali n’amaanyi mu Peetero. Kristo ayogera ku musaalaba gwe; Peetero yali asobola okutegeera ku kitiibwa, “Ggwe Kristo, Omwana wa Katonda omulamu.” Matayo 16:16. Naye waliwo ekintu ku musaalaba ne ku kufa kye yali tasobola kutegeera, n’aguma mu kwesiga kwe n’agamba nti, “Katonda akulage ekisa Mukama waffe. Bino tebirikutuukako.” Matayo 16:22. Era Kristo yalina okumunenya: “Dda ennyuma wange Setaani. Oli kyesittaza gye ndi, kubanga tolowoozeza bintu bya Katonda wabula olowooza bintu bya bantu.” Matayo 16:23. Kristo ne yeeyongera n’agamba nti, “Omuntu bw’ayagala okungoberera asaana yeefiirize yekka, yeetikke omusaalaba gwe alyoke angoberere.” Matayo 16:24. Ka tulwe ku kigambo kino kimu, “yekka” Bwe tuyiga okumanya obwannakyemalira kye ki, olwo lwokka lwe tumanya ddala ekiri ku kikolo ky’okulemererwa kwaffe kwonna, ne twetegekera okugenda eri Kristo okununulibwa. Ka tulowooze, ekisooka, ku butonde bw’obulamu buno obw’obwannakyemalira, oluvannyuma tulage ebimu ku bikolwa byabwo, oluvannyuma tubuuze ekibuuzo nti: “Tuyinza tutya okubununulibwamu?” Obwannakyemalira (nze) ge maanyi Katonda ge yatonderamu era ge yawa buli kitonde ekirina amagezi. Obwannakyemalira gwe mutima gwennyini ogw’ekitonde. Era lwaki Katonda yawa bamalayika oba omuntu obwannakyemalira? Ekigendererwa ky’obwannakyemalira buno kyali kino: tubuleete ng’ekibya ekyereere eri Katonda; alyoke abuteekemu obulamu bwe. Katonda yampa amaanyi ag’okwesalirawo, ndyoke ndeete obwannakyemalira buno buli lunaku nga ŋŋamba nti: “Ai, Katonda, kolera mu bwo; mbukuwa.” Katonda yayagala ekibya mw’ayinza okufuka obujjuvu bwe obw’obwakatonda obw’obulungi, n’amagezi, n’amaanyi. Yatonda ensi, enjuba, omwezi, emmunyeenye, emiti, ebimuli n’omuddo, byonna ebiraga obugagga bw’amagezi ge, obulungi bwe n’ekisa kye. Naye bikola ekyo nga tebimanyi kye bikola. Awo Katonda n’atonda bamalayika nga balina obwannakyemalira n’okwagala, alabe oba nga bajja kujja beewe gy’ali ku bwabwe ng’ebibya by’ajjuza. Naye woowe! Bonna tebaakola bwe batyo. Waaliwo omu eyali omukulu w’ekibiina ekinene, n’atandika okwetunuulira, n’okulowooza ku maanyi ag’ekitalo Katonda ge yali amuwadde, n’okwesanyusaamu. N’atandika okulowooza nti: “Ekitonde ng’omuntu nze kiteekwa okusigala nga kyesigamye ku Katonda bulijjo?” Ne yeegulumiza, amalala ne geeyoleka mu kweyawula ku Katonda, era mu kaseera ako kennyini, mu kifo ky’okuba malayika mu Ggulu, n’afuuka sitaani mu ggeyeena. Obwannakyemalira obukyukidde Katonda kye kitiibwa ky’okuleka Omutonzi okweyoleka mu ffe. Obwannakyemalira obukyuse ne buva ku Katonda kye kizikiza kyennyini n’omuliro ogwa ggeyeena. Ffenna tumanyi olugero olw’entiisa olw’ebyaddirira; Katonda yatonda omuntu, Setaani n’ajja mu kifaananyi ky’omusota n’akema Kaawa n’ekirowoozo eky’okufaanana Katonda, okuba n’obwannakyemalira obwetongodde, okumanya ekirungi n’ekibi. Era bwe yali ayogera naye, yamufuuwamu, mu bigambo ebyo, obutwa bwennyini n’amalala gennyini aga ggeyeena. Omwoyo gwe omubi, obutwa bwennyini obwa ggeyeena, ne buyingira mu bantu, era obwannakyemalira buno obukolimire bwe twasikira okuva ku bazadde baffe abaasooka.
