Bwe bwannakyemalira obwo obwazikiriza ensi eno ne bugireetako okuzikirira, era byonna ebibaddewo eby’ekibi, n’ekizikiza, n’obuyinike, n’obunaku; ne byonna ebiribaawo mu mirembe egitabalika egy’emirembe n’emirembe mu ggeyeena, tebiriba birala wabula obufuzi bw’obwannakyemalira, ekikolimo ky’obwannakyemalira, ekyawula omuntu ne kimukyusa okuva ku Katonda we. Era bwe tuba ab’okutegeera mu bujjuvu Kristo ky’agenda okutukolera, era ab’okugabana ku bulokozi obujjuvu, tuteekwa okuyiga okumanya obwannakyemalira buno obukolimire, okubukyawa, n’okubuleka ddala. Kale, bikolwa ki eby’obwannakyemalira? Nnyinza okwogera ku bingi, naye ka tutwale ebigambo ebisinga obwangu bye tukozesa buli kiseera: okwekulembeza okwagala kwange, okwekkiririzaamu, n’okwegulumiza. Okwekulembeza okwagala kwange, okwesanyusa, kye kibi ekinene eky’omuntu, era kye kiri ku kikolo ky’okwetabika kwonna n’ensi, okwo okuzikirizza bangi. Abantu tebasobola kutegeera lwaki tebasaanidde kwesanyusa n’okukola bye baagala. Abakristaayo bangi tebategeeranga nti Omukristaayo muntu atasaanidde kunoonya by’ayagala ye wabula bulijjo okunoonya Katonda by’ayagala, ng’omuntu omwoyo gwennyini ogwa Kristo mwe gubeera. “Mukama, nzize okukola by’oyagala, Ayi Katonda wange!” Tusanga Abakristaayo nga beesanyusa mu ngeri lukumi, naye nga bagezaako okuba abasanyufu, abalungi era ab’omugaso, so nga tebamanyi nti ku kikolo kya byonna waliwo okwekulembeza okwagala kwabwe okubanyagako omukisa. Abakristaayo, mutunuulire obulamu bwammwe mu kitangaala ky’ebigambo bya Yesu. Musangamu okwekulembeza okwagala kwammwe, okwesanyusa? Jjukira kino: buli lw’oyesanyusa, oba weegaana Yesu. Kimu ku bibiri. Oteekwa okumusanyusa Ye yekka, ne weefiiriza obwannakyemalira, oba oteekwa okwesanyusa ggwe, ne weegaana Ye. Awo ne kiddako okwekkiririzaamu, okwesiga, okufuba okw’amaanyi go, n’okwesigama ku ggwe kennyini. Kiki ekyaleetera Peetero okwegaana Yesu? Kristo yali amulabudde; lwaki teyakkiriza kulabula? Okwekkiririzaamu. Yali mukakafu nnyo: “Mukama wange, nkwagala. Emyaka esatu nga nkugoberera. Mukama wange, ŋŋaana nti ekyo kiyinza okubaawo. Neeteeseteese okusibirwa awamu naawe mu kkomera, era n’okufiira awamu naawe.” Kwali kwekkiririzaamu kwokka. Abantu emirundi mingi bambuuzizza nti, “Nsonga ki lwaki ndemererwa? Njagala nnyo, era nsaba n’obunyiikivu, okubeera mu Katonda by’ayagala.” Era emirundi mingi nziramu nti, “Kubanga weesiga ggwe kennyini.” Ne banziramu nti: “Nedda, sikola ekyo; mmanyi nti siri mulungi, era mmanyi nti Katonda mwetegefu okunkuuma, era neesiga Yesu.” Naye nziramu nti, “Nedda, owooluganda; nedda; singa weesiga Katonda ne Yesu, towandigudde, naye weesiga ggwe kennyini.” Ka tukkirize nti ensonga ya buli kulemererwa mu bulamu bw’Ekikristaayo si ndala wabula eno. Nneesiga obwannakyemalira buno obukolimire, mu kifo ky’okwesiga Yesu. Nneesiga amaanyi gange, mu kifo ky’amaanyi ga Katonda ag’obuyinza bwonna. Era eyo y’ensonga lwaki Kristo agamba nti, “Obwannakyemalira buno buteekwa okwefiirizibwa”. Waliwo okwegulumiza, engeri endala ey’ebikolwa by’obwannakyemalira. Ai, nga mu nsi ey’Ekikristaayo mulimu amalala n’obuggya bingi; nga tuwulira nnyo ebyo abantu bye boogera ku ffe oba bye batulowoozaako; nga twegomba nnyo okutenderezebwa abantu n’okusanyusa abantu, mu kifo ky’okubeeranga bulijjo mu maaso ga Katonda, n’ekirowoozo kimu: “Mmusanyusa?” Kristo yagamba nti, “Kale muyinza mutya okukkiriza nga munoonya kusiimibwa bantu bannammwe, so nga temunoonya kusiimibwa Katonda oyo Omu yekka?” Yokaana 5:44. Okunoonya ekitiibwa okuva buli omu ku munne kufuula obulamu obw’okukkiriza obutasoboka n’akatono. Obwannakyemalira buno bwava mu ggeyeena, bwatwawula ku Katonda, mulimba akolimiddwa atuwabya okuva ku Yesu. Kaakano tutuuse ku nsonga ey’okusatu. Tukole ki okubweggyako? Yesu atuddamu mu bigambo by’ekyawandiikibwa kyaffe: “Omuntu bw’ayagala okungoberera asaana yeefiirize yekka, yeetikke omusaalaba gwe alyoke angoberere.” Matayo 16:24. Kitegeere bulungi. Nteekwa okwefiiriza nze kennyini ne ntwala Yesu yennyini ng’obulamu bwange; nteekwa okulondawo. Waliwo obulamu bubiri, obulamu bw’obwannakyemalira, n’obulamu bwa Kristo; nteekwa okulondamu obumu ku bubiri. “Ngoberera,” bw’ayogera Mukama waffe, “nfuula etteeka ly’obulamu bwo, ekiragiro ky’empisa zo; mpa omutima gwo gwonna; ngoberera, nange nja kufaayo ku byonna.” Ai, mikwano gyange, kuwanyisiganya kwa maanyi okuteekeddwa mu maaso gaffe; okujja, nga tulabye akabi k’obwannakyemalira buno, n’amalala gaabwo n’obubi bwabwo, okwesuula mu maaso g’Omwana wa Katonda, ne tugamba nti, “Neefiiriza obulamu bwange, ntwala obulamu bwo okuba obwange.” Ensonga lwaki Abakristaayo basaba ne basaba obulamu bwa Kristo bubayingiremu, ne kitavaamu kantu, kwe kuba nti obulamu bw’obwannakyemalira tebwefiirizibwa. Obuuza nti, “Nnyinza ntya okweggyako obulamu buno obw’obwannakyemalira?” Omanyi olugero: omuntu yasigala mu nnyumba okutuusa ow’amaanyi omu lwe yayingira n’amugobamu. Awo ennyumba n’eyonjebwa n’erongoosebwa, naye nga nkalu, n’adda n’emyoyo emirala musanvu egimusinga obubi. Matayo 12:43-45. Kristo yekka bw’ayingira y’ayinza okugobamu obwannakyemalira, n’okubukuumira ebweru. Obwannakyemalira buno bujja kubeera naffe okutuusa ku nkomerero ddala. Mujjukire omutume Pawulo; yali alabye okwolesebwa okw’omu Ggulu, era aleme kwegulumiza, n’aweebwa eriggwa mu mubiri okumukkakkanya. Mu ye mwalimu okwegomba okwegulumiza, ekyali eky’obutonde, era kyandiwangudde, naye Kristo n’amununula okuva mu kyo olw’okumulabirira kwe okw’obwesigwa eri omuweereza we gwe yali ayagala. Yesu Kristo ayinza, olw’ekisa kye eky’obwakatonda, okuziyiza amaanyi g’obwannakyemalira obutaddamu kweyoleka wadde okufuna obuyinza; Yesu Kristo mwetegefu okufuuka obulamu bw’emmeeme; Yesu Kristo mwetegefu okutuyigiriza okumugoberera bwe tutyo, n’okuba n’omutima n’obulamu ebimussaako Ye yekka, alyoke abeere bulijjo era emirembe gyonna ekitangaala ky’emmeeme zaffe. Awo tutuuka ku ekyo omutume Pawulo ky’agamba nti: “ndi mulamu, si ku bwange, wabula ku bwa Kristo abeera mu nze” Amazima ago abiri gagenda wamu. Okusooka, “si ku bwange,” oluvannyuma, “wabula ku bwa Kristo abeera mu nze.” Abaggalatiya 2:20. Mutunuulire Peetero nate. Kristo yamugamba nti, “asaana yeefiirize yekka, yeetikke omusaalaba gwe alyoke angoberere.” Matayo 16:24. Yesu yamukulembera okutuuka e Gesusemane, era eyo Peetero n’alemererwa, kubanga yeebaka mu kiseera we yali asaanidde okutunula, ng’alindirira era ng’asaba; n’amukulembera okwolekera Gologoosa, mu kifo Peetero we yamwegaanira. Ogwo gwali bukulembeze bwa Kristo? Katonda yeebazibwe, bwe gwali. Omwoyo Omutukuvu yali tannajja mu maanyi ge; Peetero yali akyali muntu wa mubiri; omwoyo nga gwagala, naye nga tegusobola kuwangula; omubiri nga munafu. Kristo yakola ki? Yakulembera Peetero okutuusa lwe yamenyekamenyeka mu kwetoowaza okujjuvu, n’akkakkanyizibwa mu buziba bw’ennaku. Yesu n’amukulembera, n’ayita ku ntaana, n’ayita mu Kuzuukira, okutuuka ku Pentekooti, Omwoyo Omutukuvu n’ajja, era mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu Kristo n’ajja n’obulamu bwe obw’obwakatonda, olwo ne kiba nti, “Kristo abeera mu nze.” Waliwo ekkubo limu lyokka ery’okununulibwa okuva mu bulamu buno obw’obwannakyemalira. Tuteekwa okugoberera Kristo, okumussaako emitima gyaffe, okuwuliriza okuyigiriza kwe, n’okwewaayo buli lunaku abeere byonna gye tuli, era olw’amaanyi ga Kristo okwefiiriza obwannakyemalira kunaabanga kwa mukisa, ekitakoma era ekya ddala. Sisuubira n’akamu Omukristaayo okutuuka ku ssaawa emu ku ddaala w’ayinza okugamba nti, “Sikyalina bwannakyemalira bwa kwefiiriza;” era sisuubira kaseera na kamu w’ayinza okugamba nti, “Seetaaga kwefiiriza bwannakyemalira.” Nedda, okussa kuno ekimu n’omusaalaba gwa Kristo kunaabanga kwefiiriza bwannakyemalira obutakoma buli ssaawa na buli kaseera olw’ekisa kya Katonda. Tewali kifo we wabeera okununulibwa okujjuvu okuva mu buyinza bw’obwannakyemalira buno obw’ekibi. Tuteekwa okukomererwa wamu ne Kristo Yesu. Tuteekwa okubeera wamu naye ng’abo abaabatizibwa mu kufa kwe. Kirowoozeeko ekyo! Kristo teyalina bwannakyemalira bwa kibi, naye yalina obwannakyemalira (nze), era obwo yabuwaayo ddala eri okufa. Mu Gesusemane yagamba nti, “si nga Nze bwe njagala” Lukka 22:42. Obwannakyemalira obwo obutaayonoona yabuwaayo eri okufa alyoke abuddize nate okuva mu ntaana okuva eri Katonda, nga buzuukiziddwa era nga bugulumiziddwa. Tuyinza okusuubira okugenda mu Ggulu mu kkubo eddala okuggyako eryo lye yayitamu? Mwekuume! Mujjukire nti Kristo yakka mu kufa ne mu ntaana, era mu kufa kw’obwannakyemalira, nga tugoberera Yesu okutuuka ku nkomerero, mwe muliva okununulibwa n’obulamu. Era kaakano, essomo lino erya Mukama waffe tunaalikozesa tutya? Essomo erisooka liriba nti tusaanidde okumala ekiseera ne twetoowaza mu maaso ga Katonda, nga tulowooza ku obwannakyemalira buno kye buli mu ffe; tubuvunaane buli kibi, buli kubulwa, buli kulemererwa, ne byonna ebibadde bivvoola Katonda, olwo tugambe nti, “Mukama, bwe ntyo bwe ndi;” era oluvannyuma tuleke Yesu Kristo ow’omukisa okufuga ddala obulamu bwaffe, nga tukkiriza nti obulamu bwe buyinza okuba obwaffe. Temulowooza nti kintu kyangu okweggyako obwannakyemalira. Mu lukuŋŋaana olw’okwewaayo, kyangu okwelayirira, okusaba okusaba okumu, n’okukola ekikolwa eky’okwewaayo, naye ng’okufa kwa Kristo ku Gologoosa bwe kwali okw’amaanyi, okuwaayo kwe obulamu bwe obutaayonoona eri Katonda; bwe kityo bwe kiteekwa okuba eky’amaanyi wakati waffe ne Katonda waffe—okuwaayo obwannakyemalira eri okufa. Amaanyi g’okufa kwa Kristo gateekwa okujja ne gakolera mu ffe buli lunaku. Ai, lowooza enjawukana eriwo wakati wa Peetero oyo eyeekulembezanga okwagala kwe, ne Yesu ng’awaayo okwagala kwe eri Katonda! Enjawukana nga nnene wakati w’okwegulumiza kwa Peetero, n’obuwombeefu obw’obuziba obw’Omwana gw’Endiga owa Katonda, omuteefu era omuwombeefu mu mutima mu maaso ga Katonda n’abantu! Enjawukana nga nnene wakati w’okwekkiririzaamu kwa Peetero, n’okwesigama okw’obuziba okwa Yesu ku Kitaffe, bwe yagamba nti: “Nze siyinza kukola kintu kyonna ku bwange.” Tuyitibwa okubeera mu bulamu bwa Kristo, era Kristo ajja okubeera n’obulamu bwe mu ffe, naye waliwo ekintu kimu ekiteekwa okusooka okubaawo; tuteekwa okuyiga okukyawa obwannakyemalira buno n’okubwefiiriza. Nga Peetero bwe yeegaana Kristo, naffe tuteekwa okugamba nti twefiiriza obwannakyemalira, Kristo Yesu alyoke abeere byonna mu byonna. Ka twetoowaze nga tulowooza ku obwannakyemalira buno bye bututuusizzaako n’engeri gye buvvoodde Yesu; era ka tusabe n’obunyiikivu bungi: “Mukama, mu kitangaala kyo, yolesa obwannakyemalira buno; tukwegayirira obututegeeze. Zibula amaaso gaffe, tulabe bye bukoze, era nti kye kiziyiza kyokka ekibadde kituziyiza.” Ka tusabe bwe tutyo n’obunyiikivu, era oluvannyuma tulindirire Katonda okutuusa lwe tuva mu mikolo gyaffe gyonna egy’eddiini, ne mu bye tuyiseemu byonna eby’eddiini, ne mu mikisa gyaffe gyonna, okutuusa lwe tusemberera Katonda, n’okusaba kuno kumu: “Mukama Katonda, obwannakyemalira bwafuula malayika omukulu okuba sitaani, era obwannakyemalira bwazikiriza bazadde bange abaasooka ne bubaggya mu Lusuku Adeni ne bubatwala mu kizikiza ne mu nnaku, era obwannakyemalira bubadde kuzikirira kw’obulamu bwange n’ensonga ya buli kulemererwa; ai, bwolese gye ndi.” Era olwo ne kujja okuwanyisiganya okw’omukisa, omuntu n’afuulibwa omwetegefu era asobola okugamba nti: “Omulala ajja kumbeerera mu bulamu, omulala ajja kubeera nange, omulala ajja kunkolera byonna,” Tewali kirala kinaabimala. Weefiirize obwannakyemalira; weetikke omusaalaba, ofiire wamu ne Yesu; mugoberere Ye yekka. Atuwe ekisa okutegeera, okutoola, n’okubeera mu bulamu bwa Kristo.

fields.title: Okulindirira Katonda
fields.body_html:
Zabbuli 62:5.—Emmeeme yange ewummulire mu Katonda yekka; kubanga mu ye mwe muli essuubi lyange.

Ekibuuzo eky’amaanyi kitujjira: “Katonda gwe nnina, ye Katonda asinga gye ndi embeera zonna, era ali kumpi nange okusinga embeera yonna bw’eyinza okuba?” Ow’oluganda, oyize okubeera mu bulamu bwo nga Katonda ali naawe ddala buli kaseera, ne kiba nti mu mbeera ezisinga obuzibu, bulijjo abeera awo era ali kumpi naawe okusinga ekintu kyonna ekikwetoolodde? Okumanya kwaffe kwonna okw’Ekigambo kya Katonda tekulituyamba nnyo okuggyako ng’ekyo kifuuse ekibuuzo kye tufunira eky’okuddamu. Nsonga ki eyinza okuba nti abaana ba Katonda abaagalwa bangi beemulugunya bulijjo nti: “Embeera zange zinjawukanya ku Katonda; ebigezo byange, okukemebwa kwange, empisa zange, obusungu bwange, mikwano gyange, abalabe bange, buli kimu kiyinza okuyingira wakati wa Katonda wange nange?” Katonda tasobola kunfuga bw’atyo n’aba kumpi nange okusinga ekintu kyonna mu nsi? Obugagga oba obwavu, essanyu oba ennaku, biteekwa okuba n’obuyinza ku nze Katonda wange bw’atalina? Nedda.

Kale lwaki abaana ba Katonda batera okwemulugunya nti embeera zaabwe zibaawukanya ku ye? Waliwo eky’okuddamu kimu kyokka: “Tebamanyi Katonda waabwe.” Obanga mu Kkanisa ya Katonda mulimu obuzibu oba obunafu, kiri bwe kityo kubanga tetumanyi Katonda gwe tulina. Eyo ye nsonga lwaki ku kisuubizo ekiri mu Yeremiya 30:22, “nange n’abeeranga Katonda wammwe,” emirundi mingi kwongerwako ekisuubizo nti, “era mulitegeera nga nze Mukama Katonda wammwe” Bwe mmanya ekyo, si lwa kuyigiriza kwa bantu, si na magezi gange oba ebirowoozo byange; naye bwe mmanya ekyo mu bujulizi obulamu Katonda bw’assa mu mutima gwange, olwo ntegeera nti okubeerawo kwa Katonda wange okw’obwakatonda kujja kuba kwa kitalo, era Katonda wange yennyini ajja kuba mulungi nnyo, era ali kumpi nnyo, ne kiba nti nsobola okubeera ennaku zange zonna n’emyaka gyange gyonna omuwanguzi ku bw’oyo eyanjagala. Obwo si bwe bulamu bwe twetaaga? Ekibuuzo kiddamu okujja: Lwaki abantu ba Katonda tebamanyi Katonda waabwe? Eky’okuddamu kiri nti: Batwala buli kintu mu kifo kya Katonda,—abaweereza, okubuulira, ebitabo, okusaba, emirimu, n’okufuba, buli kufuba kwonna okw’obuntu, mu kifo ky’okulindirira, n’okulindirira ebbanga eddene bwe kiba kyetaagisa, okutuusa Katonda lw’ayolesa yennyini.

Tewali kuyigirizibwa kwe tuyinza kufuna, era tewali kufuba kwe tuyinza kukola, ebiyinza okututuusa ku kufuna omusana guno ogw’omukisa ogwa Katonda, ye byonna mu byonna eri emmeeme zaffe. Naye era kisoboka okukifuna. Kiri kumpi okutuukibwako singa Katonda ayolesa yennyini. Ekyo kye kintu kimu kyokka ekyetaagisa. Nsaba Katonda buli muntu yeebuuze mu mutima gwe obanga agambye era obanga agamba buli lunaku nti: “Njagala Katonda okusingawo. Tonjogerera ku mazima amalungi gokka agali mu Bayibuli. Ago tegayinza kummala. Njagala Katonda.”

Mu bulamu bwaffe obw’Ekikristaayo obw’omunda, mu kusaba kwaffe okwa buli lunaku, mu ntambula yaffe ey’Ekikristaayo, mu makanisa gaffe, mu nkuŋŋaana zaffe ez’okusaba, mu kussa kimu kwaffe, kiteekwa okutuuka ku kino—nti Katonda bulijjo y’abeera mu kifo ekisooka; era bw’akiweebwa, ajja kwetwalira obuyinza. Singa mu bulamu bwaffe kinnoomu buli liiso lyali litunuulidde Katonda, Katonda omulamu, buli mutima nga gukaaba nti, “Emmeeme yange eyaayaanira Katonda,” amaanyi ki, omukisa ki, n’okubeerawo kwa Katonda ow’emirembe n’emirembe ki ebyanditubikkuliddwa! Tusoma ki mu Abaebbulaniya 7:25?

“ayinza okulokolera ddala.”—Baani? “abajja eri Katonda ku bubwe” so si abo bokka abajja eri Kristo. Mu Kristo—erinnya lye litenderezebwe—tulina ekisa, okwetoowaza, n’obukkakkamu bwa Katonda. Naye tuli mu kabi ak’okuyimirira awo ne tumatira n’ekyo, ate nga Kristo ayagala okutuzza tusanyuke kye kimu ne mu kitiibwa kya Katonda yennyini, mu butuukirivu bwe, mu butukuvu bwe, mu buyinza bwe, mu kubeerawo kwe, ne mu maanyi ge. Asobola okulokola ddala abo abajja eri Katonda ku bubwe!

Kaakano, ebirowoozo bitono nnyo ku kkubo lye nnyinza okuyitamu okumanya Katonda nga Katonda ono asinga embeera zonna, ajjuza omutima gwange n’obulamu bwange buli lunaku. Ekintu kimu kyokka ekyetaagibwa kiri nti: Nteekwa okulindirira Katonda. Ekigambo ekyasooka,—era bwe kiri ne mu Bayibuli yaffe ey’Oluholandi, era bwe kiri ne mu mabbali,—kitegeeza emmeeme okusirika mu maaso ga Katonda: “Emmeeme yange ewummulire mu Katonda yekka; kubanga mu ye mwe muli essuubi lyange.” Zabbuli 62:5. Okusirika kw’emmeeme mu maaso ga Katonda kwandibadde kutya? Emmeeme emanyi obutono bwayo, obutamanya bwayo, endowooza zaayo enkyamu, n’akabi kaayo okuva mu kwegomba, mu byonna eby’obuntu n’eby’ekibi, emmeeme emanyi ekyo, ng’egamba nti, “Njagala Katonda ow’emirembe n’emirembe ayingire ankwate, ankwate bw’atyo ne nkuumirwa mu kibatu ky’omukono gwe obulamu bwange bwonna; njagala anfuge bw’atyo, buli kaseera akole byonna mu byonna mu nze.” Ekyo kye kiri mu butonde bwennyini obwa Katonda waffe.

Nga twandimusirikidde ne tumulindirira!

Nsobola okubuuza, n’ekitiibwa: Katonda abeerawo lwa ki? Katonda abeerawo lwa kino: okuba omusana n’obulamu bw’ebitonde, ensibuko n’amaanyi g’obulamu bwonna. Emiti emirungi, omuddo omubisi, n’enjuba eyaka Katonda bye yatonda, byali bya kulaga obulungi bwe, amagezi ge, n’ekitiibwa kye. Omuti ogw’emyaka ekikumi—bwe gwasimbibwa, Katonda teyagukwasa bulamu bwa kwemalirira ne gweyongerayo nabwo. Nedda, mazima ddala, Katonda ayambaza amalanga obulungi bwago buli mwaka buggya; buli mwaka Katonda ayambaza omuti amalagala gaagwo n’ebibala byagwo. Buli lunaku na buli ssaawa Katonda y’akuuma obulamu bw’ebitonde byonna.

Katonda yatutonda tulyoke tube ebibya mw’ayinza okukolera obulungi bwe, by’ayagala, okwagala kwe, n’okufaanana kw’Omwana we ow’omukisa. Ekyo Katonda ky’abeerawo: okukola mu ffe n’amaanyi ge ag’ekitalo, awatali kulekera awo n’akaseera kamu. Bwe ntandika okukitegeera, sikyalowooza bulamu bwa Kikristaayo obw’amazima ng’ekintu ekiri waggulu ennyo ekitasoboka era ekitali kya butonde, naye ŋŋamba nti, “Kye kintu ekisinga okuba eky’obutonde mu bitonde byonna nti Katonda abeera nange buli kaseera era nti Katonda wange aba kumpi nange okusinga ebirala byonna.” Kale lowooza akaseera katono obusirusiru obuli mu kulowooza nti siyinza kusuubira Katonda kubeera nange buli kaseera.

Tunuulira omusana gw’enjuba; wali ofunye obuzibu bwonna ng’okola oba ng’oyiga oba ng’osoma ekitabo mu musana enjuba gw’ewa? Wali ogambye nti, “Ai, nnyinza ntya okukuuma omusana guno, nnyinza ntya okugunyweza, nnyinza ntya okukakasa nti nja kweyongera okugufuna okugukozesa?” Ekyo tewali lw’okirowoozezzaako. Katonda yateekateeka enjuba yennyini ekuwe omusana, awatali kweraliikirira kwo; omusana gujja nga tegwayitiddwa. Era nkubuuza nti: Olowooza otya? Katonda yateekateeka omusana gw’enjuba eyo, ejja okwokebwa lumu, gujje gy’oli nga tomanyi, gubeere mu ggwe n’omukisa era n’amaanyi; ate Katonda tayagala, oba tasobola, kuleka musana gwe n’okubeerawo kwe okwaka mu ggwe bw’otyo n’otambula olunaku lwonna ne Katonda ng’ali kumpi naawe okusinga ekintu kyonna mu butonde? Katonda atenderezebwe olw’obukakafu buno; asobola okukikola. Kale lwaki takikola? Lwaki kibaawo emirundi mitono bwe giti, era lwaki mu kigera ekinafu bwe kityo? Waliwo eky’okuddamu kimu kyokka: tomuganya.

Okwatiddwa nnyo era ojjudde ebintu ebirala, eby’eddiini, okubuulira n’okusaba, okuyiga n’okukola, okwatiddwa nnyo eddiini yo, ne kiba nti towa Katonda biseera kwemanyisa, n’okuyingira, n’okwetwalira obuyinza. Ai, ow’oluganda, wuliriza ekigambo ky’omuntu eyamanya Katonda obulungi bwe kityo, otandike okugamba nti: “Emmeeme yange ewummulire mu Katonda yekka.” Nnandiraze nti kino kye kitiibwa kyennyini eky’Omutonzi, bwe bulamu bwennyini Kristo bwe yaleeta mu nsi, obulamu bwe yabeeramu, era bwe bulamu bwennyini Kristo bw’ayagala okutusitulirako, mu kwesigamira kwabwo kwonna ku Kitaffe.

Ekyama kyennyini eky’obulamu bwa Kristo kiri kino: okumanya okubeerawo kwa Katonda okw’engeri eyo, ne kiba nti ka abe Yuda eyajja okumulyamu olukwe, oba Kayaafa eyamusalira omusango awatali bwenkanya, oba Piraato eyamuwaayo okukomererwa, okubeerawo kwa Kitaffe kwali ku ye, ne munda mu ye, ne kumwetooloola, era omuntu teyasobola kukwata ku mwoyo gwe.

Era ekyo Katonda ky’ayagala okuba gy’oli ne gyendi.

Okutatereera kwo kwonna okw’okweraliikirira, n’okufuba kwo okutaliiko kye kugasa, tebikakasa nti tomuganyizza Katonda kukola mulimu gwe? Katonda akusika gy’ali. Kino si kyagala kyo ggwe kennyini era si kusikirizibwa kwa mutima gwo, naye magineeti ey’obwakatonda ey’emirembe n’emirembe y’ekusika. Okwegomba kuno okutawummula n’ennyonta zino, jjukira, mulimu gwa Katonda. Jjangu osirike, olindirire Katonda. Ajja kwolesa yennyini.

Nnindirira ntya Katonda? Nga nziramu, nnyinza okugamba nti: ekisooka, mu kusaba, twala ebiseera ebisingawo okusirika mu maaso ga Katonda nga toyogera kigambo na kimu. Mu kusaba, kiki ekisinga obukulu? Nti nfuna okutu kw’oyo gwe njogera naye. Tetuba beetegefu kuwaayo kwegayirira kwaffe okutuusa nga tumanyidde ddala nti tufunye okussaayo omwoyo kwa Katonda.

Ontegeeza nti ebyo byonna obimanyi. Ye, obimanyi; naye weetaaga omutima gwo okujjuzibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu n’okumanya okutukuvu nti Katonda ow’emirembe n’emirembe, Ayinzabyonna, mazima ddala ajja kumpi nnyo naawe. Oyo ow’okwagala ayaayaanira okukufuula wuwe. Sirika mu maaso ga Katonda, olindirire, ogambe nti: “Ai Katonda, nfuga. Weeyoleke, si eri ebirowoozo byange oba endowooza zange, wabula mu kumanya okw’amaanyi, okuleeta okutya okutukuvu, okukkakkanya emmeeme, nti Katonda ammulisizza okuntuusa mu kifo eky’okwesigama ku ye n’okwetoowaza”.

Okusaba kuyinza mazima ddala okuba okulindirira Katonda, naye waliwo okusaba kungi nnyo okutali kulindirira Katonda.

Okulindirira Katonda kwe kutandika okusooka era okusinga obulungi okw’okusaba. Bwe tukutama mu kukkiriza okw’obwetoowaze era okw’akasiriikiriro ekitiibwa kya Katonda n’okubeera kwe kumpi, tutandika okusaba—olwo wajja kubaawo omukisa gwennyini gwe tutera okufuna ku nkomerero yokka.

Okuva ku ntandikwa yennyini, nsisinkana Katonda maaso ku maaso; nkwatagana n’okwagala okw’emirembe n’emirembe okw’obuyinza bwonna era mmanya nti Katonda wange ajja kumpa omukisa. Tuleme kutya n’akatono okusirika mu maaso ga Katonda; olwo tujja kutwala okusirika okwo mu mulimu gwaffe; era bwe tugenda mu kkanisa ku Ssande, oba mu lukuŋŋaana olw’okusaba mu nnaku za wiiki, tujja kugenda n’okwegomba kumu, nti tewabaawo kintu kiyimirira wakati waffe ne Katonda, era tuleme kubeera nga tunyiikiridde nnyo okuwulira n’okuwuliriza ne twerabira okubeerawo kwa Katonda.

Ai, singa Katonda yandifudde buli muweereza nga Musa bwe yali wansi w’Olusozi Sinaayi; “Musa n’aggya abantu mu lusiisira n’abaleeta basisinkane Katonda,” era ddala ne bamusisinkana ne batya (Okuva 19:16). Buli muweereza asabe n’obunyiikivu bwonna emmeeme ye bw’esobola, Katonda amuwonye ekibi eky’okubuulira n’okuyigiriza nga tasoose kuleetera bantu kuwulira nti: “Omusajja ono ayagala okututwala eri Katonda yennyini.” Kino kiyinza okuwulirwa, si mu bigambo byokka, wabula ne mu ndowooza yennyini ey’omutima ogwetoowaze, ogulindirira, era ogusinza. Tuteekwa okutwala okulindirira kuno mu kusinza kwaffe kwonna; kijja kutwetaagisa okukyekenneenya; kijja kutwetaagisa okukyogerako; kijja kutwetaagisa okuyambagana, kubanga amazima gano gabuze nnyo mu Kkanisa ya Kristo; tuteekwa okulindirira Katonda olw’ago. Olwo tujja kusobola okugatwala mu bulamu bwaffe obwa buli lunaku.

Waliwo Abakristaayo bangi abeewuunya lwaki bagwa; naye lowooza ku ngeri ennyangu gye boogeramu ne beegatta mu kunyumya, ne bamalira mu kwo essaawa nnyingi, nga tebalowooza n’akatono nti bino byonna biyinza okusaasaanya amaanyi g’emmeeme ne bibaleetera okumala essaawa nga tebali mu maaso ga Katonda butereevu. Ntya nti kino kye kizibu ekinene: nti tetuli beetegefu kuwaayo ssaddaaka eyeetaagisa olw’obulamu obw’okulindirira Katonda obutakoma.

Tewali ku ffe abandiwulidde nti tekisoboka okumala buli kaseera wansi w’ekisiikirize ky’Oyo Ali Waggulu Ennyo, “anankwekanga mu weema ye” Abaagalwa, temulowooza nti kiri waggulu nnyo, oba kizibu nnyo. Kizibu nnyo gy’oli ne gyendi okukituukako, naye Katonda waffe ajja kukituwa. Ka tutandike na kaakano okulindirira Katonda n’obunyiikivu n’amaanyi okusingawo.

Mu maka gaffe ka tukutame oluusi akaseera katono mu kusirika; mu bisenge byaffe eby’okusabiramu ka tulindirire mu kusirika, tukole endagaano, oboolyawo awatali bigambo, nti n’emitima gyaffe gyonna tujja kunoonya okubeerawo kwa Katonda kujje ku ffe. Eddiini kye ki? Kyenkana Katonda w’olina ng’akola mu ggwe, ekyo kyokka ye ddiini. Era bw’oba oyagala eddiini esingawo, ekisa ekisingawo, amaanyi agasingawo, n’ebibala ebisingawo, oteekwa okuba ne Katonda okusingawo. Ekyo kibe okukaaba kw’emitima gyaffe,—Katonda okusingawo! Katonda okusingawo! Katonda okusingawo! Era ka tugambe emmeeme zaffe nti, “Emmeeme yange ewummulire mu Katonda yekka; kubanga mu ye mwe muli essuubi lyange” Zabbuli 62:5.
